name: Ninetales

name: Noivern
pokedexEntry: Although it has a violent disposition, if you give it a nice ripe fruit that it loves, Noivern will suddenly become tame.

name: Noivern
pokedexEntry: Aggressive and cruel, this Pokémon will ruthlessly torment enemies that are helpless in the dark.

name: Noivern
pokedexEntry: Flying through the darkness, it weakens enemies with ultrasonic waves that could crush stone. Its fangs finish the fight.

name: Xerneas

name: Zygarde
pokedexEntry: It's thought to be monitoring the ecosystem. There are rumors that even greater power lies hidden within it.

name: Zygarde
pokedexEntry: This is Zygarde's form when about half of its pieces have been assembled. It plays the role of monitoring the ecosystem.

name: Zygarde
pokedexEntry: Some say it can change to an even more powerful form when battling those who threaten the ecosystem.

name: Zygarde
pokedexEntry: This is Zygarde's form when about 10% of its cells have been gathered. It runs across the land at speeds greater than 60 mph.

name: Zygarde

name: Zygarde

name: Zygarde
pokedexEntry: This is Zygarde's 100% form. It has enough power to overwhelm even Xerneas or Yveltal.

name: Zygarde
pokedexEntry: This is Zygarde's perfected form. From the orifice on its chest, it radiates high-powered energy that eliminates everything.

name: Hoopa

name: Hoopa
pokedexEntry: In its true form, it possess a huge amount of power. Legends of its avarice tell how it once carried off an entire castle to gain the treasure hidden within.

name: Hoopa
pokedexEntry: It is said to be able to seize anything it desires with its six rings and six huge arms. With its powers sealed, it is transformed into a much smaller form.

name: Rowlet
pokedexEntry: This wary Pokémon uses photosynthesis to store up energy during the day, while becoming active at night.

name: Rowlet
pokedexEntry: Silently it glides, drawing near its targets. Before they even notice it, it begins to pelt them with vicious kicks.

name: Rowlet
pokedexEntry: It sends its feathers, which are as sharp as blades, flying in attack. Its legs are strong, so its kicks are also formidable.

name: Rowlet
pokedexEntry: It feels relaxed in tight, dark places and has been known to use its Trainer's pocket or bag as a nest.

name: Rowlet
pokedexEntry: At a distance, it launches its sharp feathers while flying about. If the enemy gets too close, Rowlet switches tactics and delivers vicious kicks.

name: Rowlet
pokedexEntry: During the day, it builds up energy via photosynthesis. At night, it flies silently through the sky, on the prowl for prey.

name: Dartrix
pokedexEntry: A bit of a dandy, it spends its free time preening its wings. Its preoccupation with any dirt on its plumage can leave it unable to battle.

name: Dartrix
pokedexEntry: It throws sharp feathers called blade quills at enemies or prey. It seldom misses.

name: Dartrix
pokedexEntry: This narcissistic Pokémon is a clean freak. If you don't groom it diligently, it will stop listening to you.

name: Dartrix
pokedexEntry: Supremely sensitive to the presence of others, it can detect opponents standing behind it, flinging its sharp feathers to take them out.

name: Dartrix
pokedexEntry: It throws one knifelike feather after another at its enemies, and each one precisely strikes a weak point. These feathers are known as blade quills.

name: Dartrix
pokedexEntry: It never slacks when it comes to the task of cleaning its feathers. Thorough preening keeps it looking spiffy and its blade quills nice and sharp.

name: Decidueye
pokedexEntry: It fires arrow quills from its wings with such precision, they can pierce a pebble at distances over a hundred yards.

name: Decidueye
pokedexEntry: Although basically cool and cautious, when it's caught by surprise, it's seized by panic.

name: Decidueye
pokedexEntry: It nocks its arrow quills and shoots them at opponents. When it simply can't afford to miss, it tugs the vine on its head to improve its focus.

name: Decidueye
pokedexEntry: Decidueye can nock and fire an arrow at an enemy in a tenth of a second, so its battles are decided in the blink of an eye.

name: Decidueye
pokedexEntry: As if wielding a bow, it launches the arrow quills hidden among the feathers of its wings. Decidueye's shots never miss.

name: Decidueye
pokedexEntry: In a tenth of a second, it can nock and fire an arrow quill, piercing an opponent's weak point before they notice what's happening.

name: Litten
pokedexEntry: While grooming itself, it builds up fur inside its stomach. It sets the fur alight and spews fiery attacks, which change based on how it coughs.

name: Litten
pokedexEntry: It doesn't allow its emotions to be easily seen. Earning its trust takes time. It prefers solitude.

name: Litten
pokedexEntry: If you try too hard to get close to it, it won't open up to you. Even if you do grow close, giving it too much affection is still a no-no.

name: Litten
pokedexEntry: Its coat regrows twice a year. When the time comes, Litten sets its own body on fire and burns away the old fur.

name: Litten
pokedexEntry: It spends even the smallest amount of downtime grooming its fur with its tongue. Loose fur gathers in its stomach and serves as fuel for fiery moves.

name: Litten
pokedexEntry: Trying to pet Litten before it trusts you will result in a nasty scratch from its sharp claws. Be careful.

name: Torracat
pokedexEntry: At its throat, it bears a bell of fire. The bell rings brightly whenever this Pokémon spits fire.

name: Torracat
pokedexEntry: It boasts powerful front legs. With a single punch, it can bend an iron bar right over.

name: Torracat
pokedexEntry: It can act spoiled if it grows close to its Trainer. A powerful Pokémon, its sharp claws can leave its Trainer's whole body covered in scratches.

name: Torracat
pokedexEntry: When its mane is standing on end, you can tell it's feeling good. When it isn't feeling well, its fur will lie down flat.

name: Torracat
pokedexEntry: In the midst of battle, the fire pouch on Torracat's neck rings like a bell and produces stronger flames than usual.

name: Torracat
pokedexEntry: When facing a powerful enemy, Torracat's fighting spirit gets pumped up, and its fire bell blazes hotter.

name: Incineroar
pokedexEntry: This Pokémon has a violent, selfish disposition. If it's not in the mood to listen, it will ignore its Trainer's orders with complete nonchalance.

name: Incineroar
pokedexEntry: After hurling ferocious punches and flinging furious kicks, it finishes opponents off by spewing fire from around its navel.

name: Incineroar
pokedexEntry: Although it's rough mannered and egotistical, it finds beating down unworthy opponents boring. It gets motivated for stronger opponents.

name: Incineroar
pokedexEntry: When its fighting spirit is set alight, the flames around its waist become especially intense.

name: Incineroar
pokedexEntry: It excels at violent, no-holds-barred battles. The temperature of the flames that issue from its navel exceeds 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Incineroar
pokedexEntry: Incineroar's rough and aggressive behavior is its most notable trait, but the way it helps out small Pokémon shows that it has a kind side as well.

name: Popplio
pokedexEntry: This Pokémon snorts body fluids from its nose, blowing balloons to smash into its foes. It's famous for being a hard worker.

name: Popplio
pokedexEntry: This Pokémon can control water bubbles. It practices diligently so it can learn to make big bubbles.

name: Popplio
pokedexEntry: The balloons it inflates with its nose grow larger and larger as it practices day by day.

name: Popplio
pokedexEntry: Popplio gets on top of its bouncy water balloons to jump higher. It's quite the acrobatic fighter!

name: Popplio
pokedexEntry: It creates special bouncy balloons to send at its opponents. When the balloons pop, the sheer force of their bursting is what deals damage.

name: Popplio
pokedexEntry: If Popplio want to create big, powerful balloons, they must be persistent. It takes daily practice for these Pokémon to develop their skills.

name: Brionne
pokedexEntry: A skillful dancer, it creates a sequence of water balloons as it dances, and briskly bombards its enemies.

name: Brionne
pokedexEntry: It cares deeply for its companions. When its Trainer is feeling down, it performs a cheery dance to try and help.

name: Brionne
pokedexEntry: It gets excited when it sees a dance it doesn't know. This hard worker practices diligently until it can learn that dance.

name: Brionne
pokedexEntry: It attacks by smacking its enemies with the exploding water balloons that it creates.

name: Brionne
pokedexEntry: As if dancing, it artfully dodges the attacks of its enemies. All the while, it's busy forming a bunch of balloons to overwhelm its foes.

name: Brionne
pokedexEntry: On nights when the sea is calm, Brionne dance with one another to the singing of the Primarina that's leading them.

name: Primarina
pokedexEntry: It controls its water balloons with song. The melody is learned from others of its kind and is passed down from one generation to the next.

name: Primarina
pokedexEntry: Its singing voice is its chief weapon in battle. This Pokémon's Trainer must prioritize the daily maintenance of its throat at all costs.

name: Primarina
pokedexEntry: To Primarina, every battle is a stage. It takes down its prey with beautiful singing and dancing.

name: Primarina
pokedexEntry: Also known as a songstress, it has a fantastical look on moonlit nights when it leads its colony in song.

name: Primarina
pokedexEntry: With its mouth, it makes sonic waves that sound like beautiful singing. It uses the sonic waves to control its water balloons.

name: Primarina
pokedexEntry: For Primarina, every battle's a stage. Its singing and the dancing of its balloons will mesmerize the audience.

name: Pikipek
pokedexEntry: It can peck at a rate of 16 times a second to drill holes in trees. It uses the holes for food storage and for nesting.

name: Pikipek
pokedexEntry: This Pokémon feeds on berries, whose leftover seeds become the ammunition for the attacks it fires off from its mouth.

name: Pikipek
pokedexEntry: It pecks at trees with its hard beak. You can get some idea of its mood or condition from the rhythm of its pecking.

name: Pikipek
pokedexEntry: It may look spindly, but its neck muscles are heavy-duty. It can peck at a tree 16 times per second!

name: Trumbeak
pokedexEntry: It eats berries and stores their seeds in its beak. When it encounters enemies or prey, it fires off all the seeds in a burst.

name: Trumbeak
pokedexEntry: By bending its beak, it can produce a variety of calls and brand itself a noisy nuisance for its neighbors.

name: Trumbeak
pokedexEntry: It can bend the tip of its beak to produce over a hundred different cries at will.

name: Trumbeak
pokedexEntry: From its mouth, it fires the seeds of berries it has eaten. The scattered seeds give rise to new plants.

name: Toucannon
pokedexEntry: When it battles, its beak heats up. The temperature can easily exceed 212 degrees Fahrenheit, causing severe burns when it hits.

name: Toucannon
pokedexEntry: Within its beak, its internal gas ignites, explosively launching seeds with enough power to pulverize boulders.

name: Toucannon
pokedexEntry: They smack beaks with others of their kind to communicate. The strength and number of hits tell each other how they feel.

name: Toucannon
pokedexEntry: Known for forming harmonious couples, this Pokémon is brought to wedding ceremonies as a good luck charm.

name: Yungoos
pokedexEntry: With its sharp fangs, it will bite anything. It did not originally live in Alola but was imported from another region.

name: Yungoos
pokedexEntry: It wanders around in a never-ending search for food. At dusk, it collapses from exhaustion and falls asleep on the spot.

name: Yungoos
pokedexEntry: Its stomach takes up most of its long torso. It's a big eater, so the amount Trainers have to spend on its food is no laughing matter.

name: Yungoos
pokedexEntry: Although it will eat anything, it prefers fresh living things, so it marches down streets in search of prey.

name: Gumshoos
pokedexEntry: When it finds a trace of its prey, it patiently stakes out the location...but it's always snoozing by nightfall.

name: Gumshoos
pokedexEntry: It adores having Rattata and Raticate for dinner, but as it's diurnal, it never encounters them. This Pokémon boasts incredible patience.

name: Gumshoos
pokedexEntry: Although it wasn't originally found in Alola, this Pokémon was brought over a long time ago when there was a huge Rattata outbreak.

name: Gumshoos
pokedexEntry: Patient by nature, this Pokémon loses control of itself and pounces when it spots its favorite meal—Rattata!

name: Grubbin
pokedexEntry: Its strong jaw enables it to scrape trees and slurp out the sap. It normally lives underground.

name: Grubbin
pokedexEntry: They often gather near places frequented by electric Pokémon in order to avoid being attacked by bird Pokémon.

name: Grubbin
pokedexEntry: If you find its nest, you shouldn't stick your hand inside. You'll get bitten by an irritated Grubbin.

name: Grubbin
pokedexEntry: It spits a sticky thread to stop opponents in their tracks, and then it grabs them in its sharp, sturdy mandibles to take them down.

name: Grubbin
pokedexEntry: Its natural enemies, like Rookidee, may flee rather than risk getting caught in its large mandibles that can snap thick tree branches.

name: Grubbin
pokedexEntry: It uses its big jaws to dig nests into the forest floor, and it loves to feed on sweet tree sap.

name: Charjabug
pokedexEntry: Its body is capable of storing electricity. On camping trips, people are grateful to have one around.

name: Charjabug
pokedexEntry: From the food it digests, it generates electricity, and it stores this energy in its electric sac.

name: Charjabug
pokedexEntry: It buries itself in fallen leaves and barely moves, munching away on humus. If you accidentally step on one, you'll get a shock!

name: Charjabug
pokedexEntry: Its stout shell provides excellent defense from attacks. It uses electricity on persistent opponents.

name: Charjabug
pokedexEntry: While its durable shell protects it from attacks, Charjabug strikes at enemies with jolts of electricity discharged from the tips of its jaws.

name: Charjabug
pokedexEntry: Its digestive processes convert the leaves it eats into electricity. An electric sac in its belly stores the electricity for later use.

name: Vikavolt
pokedexEntry: It zips around, on sharp lookout for an opening. It concentrates electrical energy within its large jaws and uses it to zap its enemies.

name: Vikavolt
pokedexEntry: It produces electricity via an electrical organ in its abdomen. It overwhelms bird Pokémon with shocking beams of electrical energy.

name: Vikavolt
pokedexEntry: It has an organ that generates electricity in its abdomen. It concentrates energy in its strong jaws and fires off powerful jolts of electricity.

name: Vikavolt
pokedexEntry: Vikavolt flusters opponents with acrobatic flying maneuvers. This creates an opening for it to deliver an electric beam attack.

name: Vikavolt
pokedexEntry: It builds up electricity in its abdomen, focuses it through its jaws, and then fires the electricity off in concentrated beams.

name: Vikavolt
pokedexEntry: If it carries a Charjabug to use as a spare battery, a flying Vikavolt can rapidly fire high-powered beams of electricity.

name: Crabrawler
pokedexEntry: While guarding its weak points with its pincers, it looks for an opening and unleashes punches. When it loses, it foams at the mouth and faints.

name: Crabrawler
pokedexEntry: It punches so much, its pincers often come off from overuse, but they grow back quickly. What little meat they contain is rich and delicious.

name: Crabrawler
pokedexEntry: Its hard pincers are well suited to both offense and defense. Fights between two Crabrawler are like boxing matches.

name: Crabrawler
pokedexEntry: Crabrawler has been known to mistake Exeggutor for a coconut tree and climb it. The enraged Exeggutor shakes it off and stomps it.

name: Crabominable
pokedexEntry: It aimed for the top but got lost and ended up on a snowy mountain. Being forced to endure the cold, this Pokémon evolved and grew fur.

name: Crabominable
pokedexEntry: It just throws punches indiscriminately. In times of desperation, it can lop off its own pincers and fire them like rockets.

name: Crabominable
pokedexEntry: It stores coldness in its pincers and pummels its foes. It can even smash thick walls of ice to bits!

name: Crabominable
pokedexEntry: Before it stops to think, it just starts pummeling. There are records of its turning back avalanches with a flurry of punches.

name: Oricorio
pokedexEntry: It beats its wings together to create fire. As it moves in the steps of its beautiful dance, it bathes opponents in intense flames.

name: Oricorio
pokedexEntry: This Oricorio has sipped red nectar. Its passionate dance moves cause its enemies to combust in both body and mind.

name: Oricorio
pokedexEntry: It wins the hearts of its enemies with its passionate dancing and then uses the opening it creates to burn them up with blazing flames.

name: Oricorio
pokedexEntry: This Oricorio has drunk red nectar. If its Trainer gives the wrong order, this passionate Pokémon becomes fiercely angry.

name: Oricorio
pokedexEntry: This Oricorio has sipped bright yellow nectar. Its bright, cheerful dance melts the hearts of its enemies.

name: Oricorio
pokedexEntry: It creates an electric charge by rubbing its feathers together. It dances over to its enemies and delivers shocking electrical punches.

name: Oricorio
pokedexEntry: It lifts its opponents' spirits with its cheerful dance moves. When they let their guard down, it electrocutes them with a jolt.

name: Oricorio
pokedexEntry: This Oricorio has drunk bright yellow nectar. When it sees someone looking glum, it will try to cheer them up with a dance.

name: Oricorio
pokedexEntry: This Oricorio relaxes by swaying gently. This increases its psychic energy, which it then fires at its enemies.

name: Oricorio
pokedexEntry: This Oricorio has sipped pink nectar. Its enemies' hearts melt at the sight of its gently swaying hips.

name: Oricorio
pokedexEntry: It relaxes its opponents with its elegant dancing. When they let their guard down, it showers them with psychic energy.

name: Oricorio
pokedexEntry: This Oricorio has sipped pink nectar. It gets so caught up in its dancing that it sometimes doesn't hear its Trainer's orders.

name: Oricorio
pokedexEntry: This Oricorio has sipped purple nectar. Its elegant, attractive dance will send the minds and hearts of its enemies to another world.

name: Oricorio
pokedexEntry: It summons the dead with its dreamy dancing. From their malice, it draws power with which to curse its enemies.

name: Oricorio
pokedexEntry: It charms its opponents with its refined dancing. When they let their guard down, it places a curse on them that will bring on their demise.

name: Oricorio
pokedexEntry: This Oricorio has sipped purple nectar. Some dancers use its graceful, elegant dancing as inspiration.

name: Cutiefly
pokedexEntry: It feeds on the nectar and pollen of flowers. Because it's able to sense auras, it can identify which flowers are about to bloom.

name: Cutiefly
pokedexEntry: Myriads of Cutiefly flutter above the heads of people who have auras resembling those of flowers.

name: Cutiefly
pokedexEntry: Nectar and pollen are its favorite fare. In fields of flowers, it gets into skirmishes with Butterfree over food.

name: Cutiefly
pokedexEntry: Cutiefly can pick up the auras of living things. It skillfully reads those auras to predict its foes' movements and make fools of them.

name: Cutiefly
pokedexEntry: Nectar and pollen are its favorite fare. You can find Cutiefly hovering around Gossifleur, trying to get some of Gossifleur's pollen.

name: Cutiefly
pokedexEntry: An opponent's aura can tell Cutiefly what that opponent's next move will be. Then Cutiefly can glide around the attack and strike back.

name: Ribombee
pokedexEntry: It rolls up pollen into puffs. It makes many different varieties, some used as food and others used in battle.

name: Ribombee
pokedexEntry: Some of Ribombee's pollen puffs are highly nutritious. They are sometimes sold as supplements.

name: Ribombee
pokedexEntry: Rain makes pollen damp, so Ribombee hates rain. When it sees ominous clouds, it finds a hollow in a tree, where it waits stock-still.

name: Ribombee
pokedexEntry: It can predict the weather from moisture levels and wind direction. Ribombee only reveals itself when there are a few clear days in a row.

name: Ribombee
pokedexEntry: It makes pollen puffs from pollen and nectar. The puffs' effects depend on the type of ingredients and how much of each one is used.

name: Ribombee
pokedexEntry: Ribombee absolutely hate getting wet or rained on. In the cloudy Galar region, they are very seldom seen.

name: Rockruff
pokedexEntry: It's considered to be a good Pokémon for beginners because of its friendliness, but its disposition grows rougher as it grows up.

name: Rockruff
pokedexEntry: This Pokémon has lived with people since times long ago. It can sense when its Trainer is in the dumps and will stick close by its Trainer's side.

name: Rockruff
pokedexEntry: As they develop, their disposition grows more violent and aggressive. Many Trainers find them too much to handle and abandon them.

name: Rockruff
pokedexEntry: When it rubs the rocks on its neck against you, that's proof of its love for you. However, the rocks are sharp, so the gesture is quite painful!

name: Rockruff
pokedexEntry: This Pokémon can bond very strongly with its Trainer, but it also has a habit of biting. Raising a Rockruff for a long time can be challenging.

name: Rockruff
pokedexEntry: This Pokémon intimidates opponents by striking the ground with the rocks on its neck. The moment an opponent flinches, Rockruff attacks.

name: Lycanroc
pokedexEntry: Its quick movements confuse its enemies. Well equipped with claws and fangs, it also uses the sharp rocks in its mane as weapons.

name: Lycanroc
pokedexEntry: When properly raised from a young age, it will become a trustworthy partner that will absolutely never betray its Trainer.

name: Lycanroc
pokedexEntry: The sharp rocks in its mane can cut like knives. Lycanroc wears its prey down by degrees before finishing them off.

name: Lycanroc
pokedexEntry: The rocks in its mane are sharper than a knife. Fragments that break off are treasured as good luck charms.

name: Lycanroc
pokedexEntry: This Lycanroc is calm and cautious. The rocks jutting from its mane are razor sharp.

name: Lycanroc
pokedexEntry: With swift movements, this Pokémon gradually backs its prey into a corner. Lycanroc's fangs are always aimed toward opponents' weak spots.

name: Lycanroc
pokedexEntry: The more intimidating the opponent it faces, the more this Pokémon's blood boils. It will attack with no regard for its own safety.

name: Lycanroc
pokedexEntry: It goads its enemies into attacking, withstands the hits, and in return, delivers a headbutt, crushing their bones with its rocky mane.

name: Lycanroc
pokedexEntry: It has no problem ignoring orders it doesn't like. It doesn't seem to mind getting hurt at all—as long as it can finish off its opponent.

name: Lycanroc
pokedexEntry: They live alone without forming packs. They will only listen to orders from Trainers who can draw out their true power.

name: Lycanroc
pokedexEntry: This form of Lycanroc is reckless. It charges headlong at its opponents, attacking without any care about what injuries it might receive.

name: Lycanroc
pokedexEntry: It's invigorated by powerful opponents–the stronger the better. A full-force headbutt from one of these Lycanroc can shatter giant boulders.

name: Lycanroc
pokedexEntry: Bathed in the setting sun of evening, Lycanroc has undergone a special kind of evolution. An intense fighting spirit underlies its calmness.

name: Lycanroc
pokedexEntry: This strange form is the result of its evolving at dusk. It's very rare in Alola.

name: Lycanroc
pokedexEntry: This form of Lycanroc is normally calm and quiet. Once a battle begins, however, this Pokémon displays a ferocious fighting spirit.

name: Lycanroc
pokedexEntry: These Pokémon have both calm and ferocious qualities. Their temperamental nature makes them a difficult species to raise.

name: Wishiwashi
pokedexEntry: When it's in trouble, its eyes moisten and begin to shine. The shining light attracts its comrades, and they stand together against their enemies.

name: Wishiwashi
pokedexEntry: It's awfully weak and notably tasty, so everyone is always out to get it. As it happens, anyone trying to bully it receives a painful lesson.

name: Wishiwashi
pokedexEntry: They're weak, so they move in schools. However, they can also often be seen all alone, having strayed from the school.

name: Wishiwashi
pokedexEntry: When it's in a jam, its shining eyes attract others of its kind. The light from its eyes is visible almost 25 miles away.

name: Wishiwashi
pokedexEntry: Individually, they're incredibly weak. It's by gathering up into schools that they're able to confront opponents.

name: Wishiwashi
pokedexEntry: When it senses danger, its eyes tear up. The sparkle of its tears signals other Wishiwashi to gather.

name: Wishiwashi
pokedexEntry: Weak Wishiwashi school together to concentrate their power. Their united force makes them the demon of the sea, feared near and far.

name: Wishiwashi
pokedexEntry: At their appearance, even Gyarados will flee. When they team up to use Water Gun, its power exceeds that of Hydro Pump.

name: Wishiwashi
pokedexEntry: Wishiwashi assemble in this formation to face off against strong foes. It boasts a strength that earned it the name "demon of the sea."

name: Wishiwashi
pokedexEntry: Called "demon of the sea" by some, when Wishiwashi are injured in battle and their numbers dwindle, they become a regular school.

name: Wishiwashi
pokedexEntry: On their own, they're very weak. But when Wishiwashi pool their power together in a school, they become a demon of the sea.

name: Wishiwashi
pokedexEntry: When facing tough opponents, they get into formation. But if they get wounded in battle, they'll scatter and become solitary again.

name: Mareanie
pokedexEntry: It plunges the poison spike on its head into its prey. When the prey has weakened, Mareanie deals the finishing blow with its 10 tentacles.

name: Mareanie
pokedexEntry: It's found crawling on beaches and seafloors. The coral that grows on Corsola's head is as good as a five-star banquet to this Pokémon.

name: Mareanie
pokedexEntry: They eat Corsola branches, so Mareanie are hated by craftsmen who work with Corsola branches that have naturally fallen off.

name: Mareanie
pokedexEntry: Aside from its head, its body parts regenerate quickly if they're cut off. After a good night's sleep, Mareanie is back to normal.

name: Mareanie
pokedexEntry: The first symptom of its sting is numbness. The next is an itching sensation so intense that it's impossible to resist the urge to claw at your skin.

name: Mareanie
pokedexEntry: Unlike their Alolan counterparts, the Mareanie of the Galar region have not yet figured out that the branches of Corsola are delicious.

name: Toxapex
pokedexEntry: Toxapex crawls along the ocean floor on its 12 legs. It leaves a trail of Corsola bits scattered in its wake.

name: Toxapex
pokedexEntry: Those attacked by Toxapex's poison will suffer intense pain for three days and three nights. Post-recovery, there will be some aftereffects.

name: Toxapex
pokedexEntry: To attack, this Pokémon sends toxic spikes flying at its enemies. Ones that come close get mown down by the claws on its feet.

name: Toxapex
pokedexEntry: With its 12 legs, it creates a dome to shelter within. The flow of the tides doesn't affect Toxapex in there, so it's very comfortable.

name: Toxapex
pokedexEntry: To survive in the cold waters of Galar, this Pokémon forms a dome with its legs, enclosing its body so it can capture its own body heat.

name: Toxapex
pokedexEntry: Within the poison sac in its body is a poison so toxic that Pokémon as large as Wailord will still be suffering three days after it first takes effect.

name: Mudbray
pokedexEntry: The mud stuck to Mudbray's hooves enhances its grip and its powerful running gait.

name: Mudbray
pokedexEntry: It has a stubborn, individualistic disposition. Eating dirt, making mud, and playing in the mire all form part of its daily routine.

name: Mudbray
pokedexEntry: It loves playing in the mud. If it isn't showered with mud on a daily basis, it gets stressed out and stops listening to its Trainer.

name: Mudbray
pokedexEntry: Possessing mighty power, Mudbray can be loaded with 50 times its own body weight and will be totally fine.

name: Mudbray
pokedexEntry: Loads weighing up to 50 times as much as its own body weight pose no issue for this Pokémon. It's skilled at making use of mud.

name: Mudbray
pokedexEntry: It eats dirt to create mud and smears this mud all over its feet, giving them the grip needed to walk on rough terrain without slipping.

name: Mudsdale
pokedexEntry: It spits a mud that provides resistance to both wind and rain, so the walls of old houses were often coated with it.

name: Mudsdale
pokedexEntry: Its heavy, mud-covered kicks are its best means of attack, and it can reduce large trucks to scrap without breaking a sweat.

name: Mudsdale
pokedexEntry: It remains calm and unmoving no matter the situation. It mixes dirt with the saliva in its mouth to make a special kind of mud.

name: Mudsdale
pokedexEntry: It can trudge mountain roads without rest for three days and three nights, all the while dragging a 10-ton load.

name: Mudsdale
pokedexEntry: Mud that hardens around a Mudsdale's legs sets harder than stone. It's so hard that it allows this Pokémon to scrap a truck with a single kick.

name: Mudsdale
pokedexEntry: Mudsdale has so much stamina that it could carry over 10 tons across the Galar region without rest or sleep.

name: Dewpider
pokedexEntry: It crawls onto the land in search of food. Its water bubble allows it to breathe and protects its soft head.

name: Dewpider
pokedexEntry: When it comes across enemies or potential prey, this Pokémon smashes its water-bubble-covered head into them.

name: Dewpider
pokedexEntry: When two Dewpider meet, they display their water bubbles to each other. Then the one with the smaller bubble gets out of the other's way.

name: Dewpider
pokedexEntry: It can only breathe oxygen that has dissolved in water, so it wears a water bubble on its head when it walks around on land.

name: Dewpider
pokedexEntry: It forms a water bubble at the rear of its body and then covers its head with it. Meeting another Dewpider means comparing water-bubble sizes.

name: Dewpider
pokedexEntry: Dewpider normally lives underwater. When it comes onto land in search of food, it takes water with it in the form of a bubble on its head.

name: Araquanid
pokedexEntry: It delivers headbutts with the water bubble on its head. Small Pokémon get sucked into the bubble, where they drown.

name: Araquanid
pokedexEntry: Despite what its appearance suggests, it cares for others. If it finds vulnerable, weak Pokémon, it protectively brings them into its water bubble.

name: Araquanid
pokedexEntry: It usually passes its time in the water. When its belly is full, it stores its subdued prey in the water bubble on its head.

name: Araquanid
pokedexEntry: It has a habit of storing things it values in its water bubble. If its Trainer doesn't watch out, Araquanid will try to put them in its bubble!

name: Araquanid
pokedexEntry: It launches water bubbles with its legs, drowning prey within the bubbles. This Pokémon can then take its time to savor its meal.

name: Araquanid
pokedexEntry: It acts as a caretaker for Dewpider, putting them inside its bubble and letting them eat any leftover food.

name: Fomantis
pokedexEntry: During the day, it sleeps and soaks up light. When night falls, it walks around looking for a safer place to sleep.

name: Fomantis
pokedexEntry: They give off a sweet and refreshing scent. Cutiefly often gather near the tall grass where Fomantis are hiding.

name: Fomantis
pokedexEntry: When the sun rises, Fomantis spreads its four leaves and bathes in the sunlight. The tip of its head has a pleasant aroma.

name: Fomantis
pokedexEntry: It loves the sunshine. When it basks in the sunlight regularly, it grows up with vivid coloration.

name: Fomantis
pokedexEntry: When bathed in sunlight, this Pokémon emits a pleasantly sweet scent, which causes bug Pokémon to gather around it.

name: Fomantis
pokedexEntry: During the day, Fomantis basks in sunlight and sleeps peacefully. It wakes and moves around at night.

name: Lurantis
pokedexEntry: It requires a lot of effort to maintain Lurantis's vivid coloring, but some collectors enjoy this work and treat it as their hobby.

name: Lurantis
pokedexEntry: It fires beams from its sickle-shaped petals. These beams are powerful enough to cleave through thick metal plates.

name: Lurantis
pokedexEntry: For self-protection, it pretends to be a bug Pokémon. Both of its arms bear keen-edged petals.

name: Lurantis
pokedexEntry: As it slashes into its enemies, it looks like it's dancing. Its elegant appearance has led some to call it the most glamorous Grass Pokémon.

name: Lurantis
pokedexEntry: This Pokémon resembles a beautiful flower. A properly raised Lurantis will have gorgeous, brilliant colors.

name: Lurantis
pokedexEntry: The petals on this Pokémon's arms are thin and super sharp, and they can fire laser beams if Lurantis gathers light first.

name: Morelull
pokedexEntry: It scatters spores that flicker and glow. Anyone seeing these lights falls into a deep slumber.

name: Morelull
pokedexEntry: As it drowses the day away, it nourishes itself by sucking from tree roots. It wakens at the fall of night, wandering off in search of a new tree.

name: Morelull
pokedexEntry: It scatters its shining spores around itself. Even though they're dangerous, nighttime tours of forests where Morelull live are popular.

name: Morelull
pokedexEntry: It likes damp dark places. When night falls, the spores filling the caps of its mushrooms glow.

name: Morelull
pokedexEntry: Pokémon living in the forest eat the delicious caps on Morelull's head. The caps regrow overnight.

name: Morelull
pokedexEntry: Morelull live in forests that stay dark even during the day. They scatter flickering spores that put enemies to sleep.

name: Shiinotic
pokedexEntry: Forests where Shiinotic live are treacherous to enter at night. People confused by its strange lights can never find their way home again.

name: Shiinotic
pokedexEntry: It emits flickering spores that cause drowsiness. When its prey succumb to sleep, this Pokémon feeds on them by sucking in their energy.

name: Shiinotic
pokedexEntry: It puts its prey to sleep and siphons off their vitality through the tip of its arms. If one of its kind is weakened, it helps by sending it vitality.

name: Shiinotic
pokedexEntry: When it starts fighting for territory with Parasect, the entire area gets completely coated in spores!

name: Shiinotic
pokedexEntry: Its flickering spores lure in prey and put them to sleep. Once this Pokémon has its prey snoozing, it drains their vitality with its fingertips.

name: Shiinotic
pokedexEntry: If you see a light deep in a forest at night, don't go near. Shiinotic will make you fall fast asleep.

name: Salandit
pokedexEntry: It burns its bodily fluids to create a poisonous gas. When its enemies become disoriented from inhaling the gas, it attacks them.

name: Salandit
pokedexEntry: Volcanoes or dry, craggy places are its home. It emanates a sweet-smelling poisonous gas that attracts bug Pokémon, then attacks them.

name: Salandit
pokedexEntry: The males will do whatever the females tell them. They give the females most of their food. Due to malnutrition, the males can't evolve.

name: Salandit
pokedexEntry: It weakens opponents and sends them reeling with its poisonous gas. Salandit doesn't deal well with Spinda, since it's always reeling.

name: Salandit
pokedexEntry: Its venom sacs produce a fluid that this Pokémon then heats up with the flame in its tail. This process creates Salandit's poisonous gas.

name: Salandit
pokedexEntry: This sneaky Pokémon will slink behind its prey and immobilize it with poisonous gas before the prey even realizes Salandit is there.

name: Salazzle
pokedexEntry: For some reason, only females have been found. It creates a reverse harem of male Salandit that it lives with.

name: Salazzle
pokedexEntry: Filled with pheromones, its poisonous gas can be diluted to use in the production of luscious perfumes.

name: Salazzle
pokedexEntry: Salazzle lives deep in caves and forces the Salandit it has attracted with its pheromones to serve it.

name: Salazzle
pokedexEntry: It punishes Salandit that couldn't bring it food with a fierce slap of its flame-spewing palm.

name: Salazzle
pokedexEntry: Only female Salazzle exist. They emit a gas laden with pheromones to captivate male Salandit.

name: Salazzle
pokedexEntry: The winner of competitions between Salazzle is decided by which one has the most male Salandit with it.

name: Stufful
pokedexEntry: Despite its adorable appearance, when it gets angry and flails about, its arms and legs could knock a pro wrestler sprawling.

name: Stufful
pokedexEntry: A touch from anyone except a known friend sends it into a surging frenzy. It's an incredibly dangerous Pokémon.

name: Stufful
pokedexEntry: It boasts power enough to split large trees in half. The organ on its rear releases an odor that it uses to communicate with others of its kind.

name: Stufful
pokedexEntry: Stufful hates to be hugged or touched in any way. It will squirm, thrash, and resist with amazing power.

name: Stufful
pokedexEntry: Its fluffy fur is a delight to pet, but carelessly reaching out to touch this Pokémon could result in painful retaliation.

name: Stufful
pokedexEntry: The way it protects itself by flailing its arms may be an adorable sight, but stay well away. This is flailing that can snap thick tree trunks.

name: Bewear
pokedexEntry: This immensely dangerous Pokémon possesses overwhelming physical strength. Its habitat is generally off-limits.

name: Bewear
pokedexEntry: This Pokémon has the habit of hugging its companions. Many Trainers have left this world after their spines were squashed by its hug.

name: Bewear
pokedexEntry: It waves its hands wildly in intimidation and warning. Life is over for anyone who doesn't run away as fast as possible.

name: Bewear
pokedexEntry: It boasts tremendous physical strength. Many people call it the most dangerous Pokémon in the Alola region.

name: Bewear
pokedexEntry: Once it accepts you as a friend, it tries to show its affection with a hug. Letting it do that is dangerous—it could easily shatter your bones.

name: Bewear
pokedexEntry: The moves it uses to take down its prey would make a martial artist jealous. It tucks subdued prey under its arms to carry them to its nest.

name: Bounsweet
pokedexEntry: A delectable aroma pours from its body. They are often swallowed whole by Toucannon lured by that wafting deliciousness.

name: Bounsweet
pokedexEntry: Although it's too sugary for human consumption, Bounsweet's sweat can be watered down into a juice with just the right amount of sweetness.

name: Bounsweet
pokedexEntry: Because of its sweet, delicious aroma, bird Pokémon are always after it, but it's not intelligent enough to care.

name: Bounsweet
pokedexEntry: It tries to resist being swallowed by a bird Pokémon by spinning the sepals on its head. It's usually a fruitless attempt.

name: Bounsweet
pokedexEntry: Its body gives off a sweet, fruity scent that is extremely appetizing to bird Pokémon.

name: Bounsweet
pokedexEntry: When under attack, it secretes a sweet and delicious sweat. The scent only calls more enemies to it.

name: Steenee
pokedexEntry: The sepals on its head developed to protect its body. These are quite hard, so even if pecked by bird Pokémon, this Pokémon is totally fine.

name: Steenee
pokedexEntry: This Pokémon is always bouncing around energetically. Other Pokémon are attracted by its lively appearance and pleasant aroma.

name: Steenee
pokedexEntry: It's protected by its hard sepals, so it plays with bird Pokémon without worry. They peck it relentlessly, but it doesn't care.

name: Steenee
pokedexEntry: It bounces around, swinging the sepals on its head with abandon. They're quite painful when they smack you!

name: Steenee
pokedexEntry: As it twirls like a dancer, a sweet smell spreads out around it. Anyone who inhales the scent will feel a surge of happiness.

name: Steenee
pokedexEntry: Any Corvisquire that pecks at this Pokémon will be greeted with a smack from its sepals followed by a sharp kick.

name: Tsareena
pokedexEntry: Its long, striking legs aren't just for show but to be used to kick with skill. In victory, it shows off by kicking the defeated, laughing boisterously.

name: Tsareena
pokedexEntry: A Pokémon known for the beauty of its well-shaped legs, it sometimes appears as a mascot in advertisements for beauty salons.

name: Tsareena
pokedexEntry: A master of grand and beautiful kicks, it can knock out even kickboxing champions with a single blow.

name: Tsareena
pokedexEntry: A Pokémon with an aggressive personality and a mastery of kicking, it cackles every time it kicks an opponent.

name: Tsareena
pokedexEntry: This feared Pokémon has long, slender legs and a cruel heart. It shows no mercy as it stomps on its opponents.

name: Tsareena
pokedexEntry: A kick from the hardened tips of this Pokémon's legs leaves a wound in the opponent's body and soul that will never heal.

name: Comfey
pokedexEntry: It attaches flowers to its highly nutritious vine. This revitalizes the flowers, and they give off an aromatic scent.

name: Comfey
pokedexEntry: Baths prepared with the flowers from its vine have a relaxing effect, so this Pokémon is a hit with many people.

name: Comfey
pokedexEntry: It stretches sticky vines out from its head and picks flowers to adorn itself with. When it doesn't have any flowers, it feels uneasy.

name: Comfey
pokedexEntry: It picks flowers and sticks them to its body with fluids it produces. The aroma that wafts from its petals has a healing effect.

name: Comfey
pokedexEntry: Comfey picks flowers with its vine and decorates itself with them. For some reason, flowers won't wither once they're attached to a Comfey.

name: Comfey
pokedexEntry: These Pokémon smell very nice. All Comfey wear different flowers, so each of these Pokémon has its own individual scent.

name: Oranguru
pokedexEntry: Known for its extreme intelligence, this Pokémon will look down on inexperienced Trainers, so it's best suited to veteran Trainers.

name: Oranguru
pokedexEntry: Deep in the jungle, high in the lofty canopy, this Pokémon abides. On rare occasions, it shows up at the beach to match wits with Slowking.

name: Oranguru
pokedexEntry: It normally spends its time meditating in the treetops. It throws Poké Balls and gives other Pokémon orders as it pleases.

name: Oranguru
pokedexEntry: Oranguru don't get along with each other, so they're always engaging in battles of wits to decide which one is superior.

name: Oranguru
pokedexEntry: With waves of its fan—made from leaves and its own fur—Oranguru skillfully gives instructions to other Pokémon.

name: Oranguru
pokedexEntry: It knows the forest inside and out. If it comes across a wounded Pokémon, Oranguru will gather medicinal herbs to treat it.

name: Passimian
pokedexEntry: They form groups of roughly 20 individuals. Their mutual bond is remarkable—they will never let down a comrade.

name: Passimian
pokedexEntry: They battle with hard berries for weapons. Their techniques are passed from the boss to the group, generation upon generation.

name: Passimian
pokedexEntry: They use their saliva to stick leaves to their shoulders. You can tell what troop they belong to from the position of the leaves.

name: Passimian
pokedexEntry: Berries are its weapons as well as the staple of its diet. The one that can throw a berry the farthest is the boss of the troop.

name: Passimian
pokedexEntry: Displaying amazing teamwork, they follow the orders of their boss as they all help out in the search for their favorite berries.

name: Passimian
pokedexEntry: Passimian live in groups of about 20, with each member performing an assigned role. Through cooperation, the group survives.

name: Wimpod
pokedexEntry: This Pokémon is a coward. As it desperately dashes off, the flailing of its many legs leaves a sparkling clean path in its wake.

name: Wimpod
pokedexEntry: Its habitat varies from beaches to seabeds. A natural scavenger, it will gleefully chow down on anything edible, no matter how rotten.

name: Wimpod
pokedexEntry: It will pick up anything it finds on the ground. Sometimes it finds coins, so Murkrow and Meowth will go after it.

name: Wimpod
pokedexEntry: An astonishingly cowardly Pokémon, Wimpod will whir its legs at high speeds to run away if anything comes near it.

name: Wimpod
pokedexEntry: It's nature's cleaner—it eats anything and everything, including garbage and rotten things. The ground near its nest is always clean.

name: Wimpod
pokedexEntry: Wimpod gather in swarms, constantly on the lookout for danger. They scatter the moment they detect an enemy's presence.

name: Golisopod
pokedexEntry: With a flashing slash of its giant sharp claws, it cleaves seawater—or even air—right in two.

name: Golisopod
pokedexEntry: It battles skillfully with its six arms, but spends most of its time peacefully meditating in caves deep beneath the sea.

name: Golisopod
pokedexEntry: The shell covering its body is as hard as diamond. This Pokémon will do anything it takes to win.

name: Golisopod
pokedexEntry: Its claws, which it can extend and retract at will, are its greatest weapons. Golisopod is sometimes accompanied by Wimpod.

name: Golisopod
pokedexEntry: It will do anything to win, taking advantage of every opening and finishing opponents off with the small claws on its front legs.

name: Golisopod
pokedexEntry: They live in sunken ships or in holes in the seabed. When Golisopod and Grapploct battle, the loser becomes the winner's meal.

name: Sandygast
pokedexEntry: Born from a sand mound playfully built by a child, this Pokémon embodies the grudges of the departed.

name: Sandygast
pokedexEntry: It takes control of anyone who puts a hand in its mouth. And so it adds to the accumulation of its sand-mound body.

name: Sandygast
pokedexEntry: It likes the shovel on its head, so Sandygast will get serious and fight any children who come to take it back.

name: Sandygast
pokedexEntry: If you build sand mounds when you're playing, destroy them before you go home, or they may get possessed and become Sandygast.

name: Sandygast
pokedexEntry: Grudges of the dead have possessed a mound of sand and become a Pokémon. Sandygast is fond of the shovel on its head.

name: Sandygast
pokedexEntry: Sandygast mainly inhabits beaches. It takes control of anyone who puts their hand into its mouth, forcing them to make its body bigger.

name: Palossand
pokedexEntry: Possessed people controlled by this Pokémon transformed its sand mound into a castle. As it evolved, its power to curse grew ever stronger.

name: Palossand
pokedexEntry: Buried beneath the castle are masses of dried-up bones from those whose vitality it has drained.

name: Palossand
pokedexEntry: Each of its grains of sand has its own will. Palossand eats small Pokémon and siphons away their vital essence while they're still alive.

name: Palossand
pokedexEntry: Once it has whipped up a sandstorm to halt its opponents in their tracks, this terrifying Pokémon snatches away their vitality.

name: Palossand
pokedexEntry: Palossand is known as the Beach Nightmare. It pulls its prey down into the sand by controlling the sand itself, and then it sucks out their souls.

name: Palossand
pokedexEntry: This Pokémon lives on beaches, but it hates water. Palossand can't maintain its castle-like shape if it gets drenched by a heavy rain.

name: Pyukumuku
pokedexEntry: It lives in shallow seas, such as areas near a beach. It can eject its internal organs, which it uses to engulf its prey or battle enemies.

name: Pyukumuku
pokedexEntry: These Pokémon line the beaches. The sticky mucous that covers their bodies can be used to soothe sunburned skin. How convenient!

name: Pyukumuku
pokedexEntry: The tradition known as Pyukumuku chucking started from the custom of throwing Pyukumuku back into the sea after they wash onshore.

name: Pyukumuku
pokedexEntry: Its entire body is covered in its own slime. If you accidentally step on one, you'll slip, and it will get mad and smack you!

name: Pyukumuku
pokedexEntry: It lives in warm, shallow waters. If it encounters a foe, it will spit out its internal organs as a means to punch them.

name: Pyukumuku
pokedexEntry: It's covered in a slime that keeps its skin moist, allowing it to stay on land for days without drying up.

name: Type: Null
pokedexEntry: The heavy control mask it wears suppresses its intrinsic capabilities. This Pokémon has some hidden special power.

name: Type: Null
pokedexEntry: Due to the danger that this synthetic Pokémon may go on a rampage, it wears a control mask to restrain its power.

name: Type: Null
pokedexEntry: A Pokémon weapon developed for a specific mission, it went berserk during an experiment, so it was cryogenically frozen.

name: Type: Null
pokedexEntry: There's danger of its going on a rampage, so its true power is sealed away beneath its control mask.

name: Type: Null
pokedexEntry: Rumor has it that the theft of top-secret research notes led to a new instance of this Pokémon being created in the Galar region.

name: Type: Null
pokedexEntry: It was modeled after a mighty Pokémon of myth. The mask placed upon it limits its power in order to keep it under control.

name: Silvally
pokedexEntry: Its trust in its partner is what awakens it. This Pokémon is capable of changing its type, a flexibility that is well displayed in battle.

name: Silvally
pokedexEntry: Although its name was Type: Null at first, the boy who evolved it into this form gave it the name by which it is now known.

name: Silvally
pokedexEntry: This is its form once it has awakened and evolved. Freed from its heavy mask, its speed is greatly increased.

name: Silvally
pokedexEntry: Through the bond it formed with its Trainer, its will was strengthened, and it was able to destroy its control mask.

name: Silvally
pokedexEntry: A solid bond of trust between this Pokémon and its Trainer awakened the strength hidden within Silvally. It can change its type at will.

name: Silvally
pokedexEntry: The final factor needed to release this Pokémon's true power was a strong bond with a Trainer it trusts.

name: Minior
pokedexEntry: Originally making its home in the ozone layer, it hurtles to the ground when the shell enclosing its body grows too heavy.

name: Minior
pokedexEntry: Strong impacts can knock it out of its shell. This Pokémon was born from mutated nanoparticles.

name: Minior
pokedexEntry: It lives in the ozone layer, where it becomes food for stronger Pokémon. When it tries to run away, it falls to the ground.

name: Minior
pokedexEntry: Although its outer shell is uncommonly durable, the shock of falling to the ground smashes the shell to smithereens.

name: Minior
pokedexEntry: It eats dust in the atmosphere. The composition of the dust determines the color of its core.

name: Minior
pokedexEntry: If its core stays exposed, it will soon die off. It's possible that it may survive if it's put into a Poké Ball quickly enough.

name: Minior
pokedexEntry: Places where Minior fall from the night sky are few and far between, with Alola being one of the precious few.

name: Minior
pokedexEntry: This is its form when its shell has fallen off. The color of its core depends on the materials that made up the food it ate.

name: Komala
pokedexEntry: It is born asleep, and it dies asleep. All its movements are apparently no more than the results of it tossing and turning in its dreams.

name: Komala
pokedexEntry: The log it holds was given to it by its parents at birth. It has also been known to cling to the arm of a friendly Trainer.

name: Komala
pokedexEntry: It stays asleep from the moment it's born. When it falls into a deep sleep, it stops moving altogether.

name: Komala
pokedexEntry: It remains asleep from birth to death as a result of the sedative properties of the leaves that form its diet.

name: Turtonator
pokedexEntry: The shell on its back is chemically unstable and explodes violently if struck. The hole in its stomach is its weak point.

name: Turtonator
pokedexEntry: It gushes fire and poisonous gases from its nostrils. Its dung is an explosive substance and can be put to various uses.

name: Turtonator
pokedexEntry: It lives in volcanoes and eats sulfur and other minerals. Materials from the food it eats form the basis of its explosive shell.

name: Turtonator
pokedexEntry: Its exploding shell poses a real danger but is sensitive to moisture. On rainy days, Turtonator takes silent refuge in caves.

name: Turtonator
pokedexEntry: Explosive substances coat the shell on its back. Enemies that dare attack it will be blown away by an immense detonation.

name: Turtonator
pokedexEntry: Eating sulfur in its volcanic habitat is what causes explosive compounds to develop in its shell. Its droppings are also dangerously explosive.

name: Togedemaru
pokedexEntry: The spiny fur on its back is normally at rest. When this Pokémon becomes agitated, its fur stands on end and stabs into its attackers.

name: Togedemaru
pokedexEntry: The long hairs on its back act as lightning rods. The bolts of lightning it attracts are stored as energy in its electric sac.

name: Togedemaru
pokedexEntry: When it's surprised or agitated, the 14 fur spikes on its back will stand up involuntarily.

name: Togedemaru
pokedexEntry: Its capacity to produce electricity is somewhat limited, so it gets charged up by letting lightning strike it!

name: Togedemaru
pokedexEntry: With the long hairs on its back, this Pokémon takes in electricity from other electric Pokémon. It stores what it absorbs in an electric sac.

name: Togedemaru
pokedexEntry: When it's in trouble, it curls up into a ball, makes its fur spikes stand on end, and then discharges electricity indiscriminately.

name: Mimikyu
pokedexEntry: Its actual appearance is unknown. A scholar who saw what was under its rag was overwhelmed by terror and died from the shock.

name: Mimikyu
pokedexEntry: A lonely Pokémon, it conceals its terrifying appearance beneath an old rag so it can get closer to people and other Pokémon.

name: Mimikyu
pokedexEntry: Although it's a quiet, lonely Pokémon, if you try to look at what's under its rag, it will become agitated and resist violently.

name: Mimikyu
pokedexEntry: A gust of wind revealed what hides under this Pokémon's rag to a passing Trainer, who went home and died painfully that very night.

name: Mimikyu
pokedexEntry: It wears a rag fashioned into a Pikachu costume in an effort to look less scary. Unfortunately, the costume only makes it creepier.

name: Mimikyu
pokedexEntry: There was a scientist who peeked under Mimikyu's old rag in the name of research. The scientist died of a mysterious disease.

name: Mimikyu
pokedexEntry: After going to all the effort of disguising itself, its neck was broken. Whatever is inside is probably unharmed, but it's still feeling sad.

name: Mimikyu
pokedexEntry: If its neck is broken or its rag torn during an attack, it works through the night to patch it.

name: Mimikyu
pokedexEntry: It stands in front of a mirror, trying to fix its broken neck as if its life depended on it. It has a hard time getting it right, so it's crying inside.

name: Mimikyu
pokedexEntry: Sad that its true identity may be exposed, Mimikyu will mercilessly seek revenge on any opponent that breaks its neck.

name: Mimikyu
pokedexEntry: There will be no forgiveness for any who reveal that it was pretending to be Pikachu. It will bring the culprit down, even at the cost of its own life.

name: Mimikyu
pokedexEntry: Its disguise made from an old rag allowed it to avoid an attack, but the impact broke the neck of the disguise. Now everyone knows it's a Mimikyu.

name: Bruxish
pokedexEntry: When it unleashes its psychic power from the protuberance on its head, the grating sound of grinding teeth echoes through the area.

name: Bruxish
pokedexEntry: It stuns its prey with psychokinesis and then grinds them to mush with its strong teeth. Even Shellder's shell is no match for it.

name: Bruxish
pokedexEntry: It burrows beneath the sand, radiating psychic power from the protuberance on its head. It waits for prey as it surveys the area.

name: Bruxish
pokedexEntry: Its skin is thick enough to fend off Mareanie's spikes. With its robust teeth, Bruxish crunches up the spikes and eats them.

name: Drampa
pokedexEntry: It has a compassionate personality, but if it is angered, it completely destroys its surroundings with its intense breath.

name: Drampa
pokedexEntry: This Pokémon is friendly to people and loves children most of all. It comes from deep in the mountains to play with children it likes in town.

name: Drampa
pokedexEntry: If a child it has made friends with is bullied, Drampa will find the bully's house and burn it to the ground.

name: Drampa
pokedexEntry: It appears in towns and plays with the children. Drampa will protect kids when they're in danger, so their moms don't have to worry.

name: Drampa
pokedexEntry: The mountains it calls home are nearly two miles in height. On rare occasions, it descends to play with the children living in the towns below.

name: Drampa
pokedexEntry: Drampa is a kind and friendly Pokémon—up until it's angered. When that happens, it stirs up a gale and flattens everything around.

name: Dhelmise
pokedexEntry: Swinging its massive anchor, it can KO Wailord in a single blow. What appears to be green seaweed is actually its body.

name: Dhelmise
pokedexEntry: The soul of seaweed adrift in the waves became reborn as this Pokémon. It maintains itself with new infusions of seabed detritus and seaweed.

name: Dhelmise
pokedexEntry: It wraps its prey in green seaweed and sucks away their vitality. It only likes to go after big prey like Wailord.

name: Dhelmise
pokedexEntry: Its chain-like green seaweed can stretch outward for hundreds of yards. For some reason, it gets along well with Skrelp.

name: Dhelmise
pokedexEntry: After a piece of seaweed merged with debris from a sunken ship, it was reborn as this ghost Pokémon.

name: Dhelmise
pokedexEntry: After lowering its anchor, it waits for its prey. It catches large Wailord and drains their life-force.

name: Jangmo-o
pokedexEntry: It expresses its feelings by smacking its scales. Metallic sounds echo through the tall mountains where Jangmo-o lives.

name: Jangmo-o
pokedexEntry: They live in mountains where no trace of humans can be detected. Jangmo-o grow little by little as they battle one another.

name: Jangmo-o
pokedexEntry: It smacks the scales on its head against rocks or against the ground to frighten its opponents. It can also contact its friends with these noises.

name: Jangmo-o
pokedexEntry: It will never show an enemy its back in battle. Ancient warriors liked Jangmo-o for its valiant disposition and made it one of their own.

name: Jangmo-o
pokedexEntry: They learn to fight by smashing their head scales together. The dueling strengthens both their skills and their spirits.

name: Jangmo-o
pokedexEntry: Jangmo-o strikes its scales to communicate with others of its kind. Its scales are actually fur that's become as hard as metal.

name: Hakamo-o
pokedexEntry: It leaps at its prey with a courageous shout. Its scaly punches tear its opponents to shreds.

name: Hakamo-o
pokedexEntry: It sheds and regrows its scales on a continuous basis. The scales become harder and sharper each time they're regrown.

name: Hakamo-o
pokedexEntry: It makes noise by clanging its scales together. When the rhythm has reached its peak, Hakamo-o attacks.

name: Hakamo-o
pokedexEntry: The scales it sheds can be molded and processed to make pots and pans. They conduct heat well, so they're a popular item.

name: Hakamo-o
pokedexEntry: The scaleless, scarred parts of its body are signs of its strength. It shows them off to defeated opponents.

name: Hakamo-o
pokedexEntry: Before attacking its enemies, it clashes its scales together and roars. Its sharp claws shred the opposition.

name: Kommo-o
pokedexEntry: When it spots enemies, it threatens them by jingling the scales on its tail. Weak opponents will crack and flee in panic.

name: Kommo-o
pokedexEntry: Its rigid scales function as offense and defense. In the past, its scales were processed and used to make weapons and other commodities.

name: Kommo-o
pokedexEntry: When it howls after finishing off its prey, the metallic sounds of its celebrating comrades can be heard from all around.

name: Kommo-o
pokedexEntry: It battles valiantly with its fists, which are armored in steel scales. Kommo-o specializes in uppercuts.

name: Kommo-o
pokedexEntry: It clatters its tail scales to unnerve opponents. This Pokémon will battle only those who stand steadfast in the face of this display.

name: Kommo-o
pokedexEntry: Certain ruins have paintings of ancient warriors wearing armor made of Kommo-o scales.

name: Tapu Koko
pokedexEntry: This guardian deity of Melemele is brimming with curiosity. It summons thunderclouds and stores their lightning inside its body.

name: Tapu Koko
pokedexEntry: It confuses its enemies by flying too quickly for the eye to follow. It has a hair-trigger temper but forgets what made it angry an instant later.

name: Tapu Koko
pokedexEntry: Although it's called a guardian deity, if a person or Pokémon puts it in a bad mood, it will become a malevolent deity and attack.

name: Tapu Koko
pokedexEntry: The lightning-wielding guardian deity of Melemele, Tapu Koko is brimming with curiosity and appears before people from time to time.

name: Tapu Koko
pokedexEntry: Although it's called a guardian deity, if a person or Pokémon puts it in a bad mood, it will become a malevolent deity and attack.

name: Tapu Koko
pokedexEntry: The lightning-wielding guardian deity of Melemele, Tapu Koko is brimming with curiosity and appears before people from time to time.

name: Tapu Lele
pokedexEntry: This guardian deity of Akala is guilelessly cruel. The fragrant aroma of flowers is the source of its energy.

name: Tapu Lele
pokedexEntry: As it flutters about, it scatters its strangely glowing scales. Touching them is said to restore good health on the spot.

name: Tapu Lele
pokedexEntry: It heals the wounds of people and Pokémon by sprinkling them with its sparkling scales. This guardian deity is worshiped on Akala.

name: Tapu Lele
pokedexEntry: Although called a guardian deity, Tapu Lele is devoid of guilt about its cruel disposition and can be described as nature incarnate.

name: Tapu Lele
pokedexEntry: It heals the wounds of people and Pokémon by sprinkling them with its sparkling scales. This guardian deity is worshiped on Akala.

name: Tapu Lele
pokedexEntry: Although called a guardian deity, Tapu Lele is devoid of guilt about its cruel disposition and can be described as nature incarnate.

name: Tapu Bulu
pokedexEntry: It pulls large trees up by the roots and swings them around. It causes vegetation to grow, and then it absorbs energy from the growth.

name: Tapu Bulu
pokedexEntry: The guardian deity of Ula'ula is a lazy Pokémon. It commands plants to immobilize its foes and then deals them a savage blow with its horns.

name: Tapu Bulu
pokedexEntry: Although it's called a guardian deity, it's violent enough to crush anyone it sees as an enemy.

name: Tapu Bulu
pokedexEntry: It makes ringing sounds with its tail to let others know where it is, avoiding unneeded conflicts. This guardian deity of Ula'ula controls plants.

name: Tapu Bulu
pokedexEntry: Although it's called a guardian deity, it's violent enough to crush anyone it sees as an enemy.

name: Tapu Bulu
pokedexEntry: It makes ringing sounds with its tail to let others know where it is, avoiding unneeded conflicts. This guardian deity of Ula'ula controls plants.

name: Tapu Fini
pokedexEntry: The dense fog it creates brings the downfall and destruction of its confused enemies. Ocean currents are the source of its energy.

name: Tapu Fini
pokedexEntry: The guardian deity of Poni, it can control water. People say it can create pure water that will wash away any uncleanness.

name: Tapu Fini
pokedexEntry: This guardian deity of Poni Island manipulates water. Because it lives deep within a thick fog, it came to be both feared and revered.

name: Tapu Fini
pokedexEntry: Although it's called a guardian deity, terrible calamities sometimes befall those who recklessly approach Tapu Fini.

name: Tapu Fini
pokedexEntry: This guardian deity of Poni Island manipulates water. Because it lives deep within a thick fog, it came to be both feared and revered.

name: Tapu Fini
pokedexEntry: Although it's called a guardian deity, terrible calamities sometimes befall those who recklessly approach Tapu Fini.

name: Cosmog
pokedexEntry: Its body is gaseous and frail. It slowly grows as it collects dust from the atmosphere.

name: Cosmog
pokedexEntry: In ages past, it was called the child of the stars. It's said to be a Pokémon from another world, but no specific details are known.

name: Cosmog
pokedexEntry: Even though its helpless, gaseous body can be blown away by the slightest breeze, it doesn't seem to care.

name: Cosmog
pokedexEntry: Whether or not it's a Pokémon from this world is a mystery. When it's in a jam, it warps away to a safe place to hide.

name: Cosmog
pokedexEntry: This Pokémon came from another universe. Its gaseous body is so light that even a gentle breeze can blow it away.

name: Cosmog
pokedexEntry: Cosmog is very curious but not very cautious, often placing itself in danger. If things start to look dicey, it teleports away.

name: Cosmoem
pokedexEntry: Motionless as if dead, its body is faintly warm to the touch. In the distant past, it was called the cocoon of the stars.

name: Cosmoem
pokedexEntry: There's something accumulating around the black core within its hard shell. People think this Pokémon may come from another world.

name: Cosmoem
pokedexEntry: The king who ruled Alola in times of antiquity called it the "cocoon of the stars" and built an altar to worship it.

name: Cosmoem
pokedexEntry: As it absorbs light, Cosmoem continues to grow. Its golden shell is surprisingly solid.

name: Cosmoem
pokedexEntry: The absorption of starlight fuels this Pokémon's growth. The shell that encases it is harder than any known material.

name: Cosmoem
pokedexEntry: It sucks in dust from the air at an astounding rate, frantically building up energy within its core as preparation for evolution.

name: Solgaleo
pokedexEntry: It is said to live in another world. The intense light it radiates from the surface of its body can make the darkest of nights light up like midday.

name: Solgaleo
pokedexEntry: This Pokémon is said to be a male evolution of Cosmog. At the activation of its third eye, it departs for another world.

name: Solgaleo
pokedexEntry: Sometimes the result of its opening an Ultra Wormhole is that energy and life-forms from other worlds are called here to this world.

name: Solgaleo
pokedexEntry: In writings from the distant past, it's called by the name "the beast that devours the sun."

name: Solgaleo
pokedexEntry: When light radiates from its body, this Pokémon could almost appear to be the sun. It will dispel any darkness and light up the world.

name: Solgaleo
pokedexEntry: Solgaleo was once known as the Beast That Devours the Sun. Energy in the form of light radiates boundlessly from it.

name: Lunala
pokedexEntry: It is said to be a female evolution of Cosmog. When its third eye activates, away it flies to another world.

name: Lunala
pokedexEntry: Said to live in another world, this Pokémon devours light, drawing the moonless dark veil of night over the brightness of day.

name: Lunala
pokedexEntry: Records of it exist in writings from long, long ago, where it was known by the name "the beast that calls the moon."

name: Lunala
pokedexEntry: It sometimes summons unknown powers and life-forms here to this world from holes that lead to other worlds.

name: Lunala
pokedexEntry: Known as the Beast That Calls the Moon, this Pokémon lives by taking in any and all light and converting it into its own energy.

name: Lunala
pokedexEntry: It steals the light from its surroundings and then becomes the full moon, showering its own light across the night sky.

name: Nihilego
pokedexEntry: One of several mysterious Ultra Beasts. People on the street report observing those infested by it suddenly becoming violent.

name: Nihilego
pokedexEntry: One of the Ultra Beasts. It's unclear whether or not this Pokémon is sentient, but sometimes it can be observed behaving like a young girl.

name: Nihilego
pokedexEntry: A life-form from another world, it was dubbed a UB and is thought to produce a strong neurotoxin.

name: Nihilego
pokedexEntry: It appeared in this world from an Ultra Wormhole. Nihilego appears to be a parasite that lives by feeding on people and Pokémon.

name: Nihilego
pokedexEntry: A life-form from another world, it was dubbed a UB and is thought to produce a strong neurotoxin.

name: Nihilego
pokedexEntry: It appeared in this world from an Ultra Wormhole. Nihilego appears to be a parasite that lives by feeding on people and Pokémon.

name: Buzzwole
pokedexEntry: This Ultra Beast appeared from another world. It shows off its body, but whether that display is a boast or a threat remains unclear.

name: Buzzwole
pokedexEntry: A mysterious life-form called an Ultra Beast. Witnesses saw it pulverize a dump truck with a single punch.

name: Buzzwole
pokedexEntry: Although it's alien to this world and a danger here, it's apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

name: Buzzwole
pokedexEntry: Buzzwole goes around showing off its abnormally swollen muscles. It is one kind of Ultra Beast.

name: Buzzwole
pokedexEntry: Although it's alien to this world and a danger here, it's apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

name: Buzzwole
pokedexEntry: Buzzwole goes around showing off its abnormally swollen muscles. It is one kind of Ultra Beast.

name: Pheromosa
pokedexEntry: One of the dangerous Ultra Beasts, it has been spotted running across the land at terrific speeds.

name: Pheromosa
pokedexEntry: One of the Ultra Beasts. It refuses to touch anything, perhaps because it senses some uncleanness in this world.

name: Pheromosa
pokedexEntry: A life-form that lives in another world, its body is thin and supple, but it also possesses great power.

name: Pheromosa
pokedexEntry: Although it's alien to this world and a danger here, it's apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

name: Pheromosa
pokedexEntry: A life-form that lives in another world, its body is thin and supple, but it also possesses great power.

name: Pheromosa
pokedexEntry: Although it's alien to this world and a danger here, it's apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

name: Xurkitree
pokedexEntry: One of the mysterious life-forms known as Ultra Beasts. Astonishing electric shocks emanate from its entire body, according to witnesses.

name: Xurkitree
pokedexEntry: It appeared from the Ultra Wormhole. It raided a power plant, so people think it energizes itself with electricity.

name: Xurkitree
pokedexEntry: Although it's alien to this world and a danger here, it's apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

name: Xurkitree
pokedexEntry: They've been dubbed Ultra Beasts. Some of them stand unmoving, like trees, with their arms and legs stuck into the ground.

name: Xurkitree
pokedexEntry: Although it's alien to this world and a danger here, it's apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

name: Xurkitree
pokedexEntry: They've been dubbed Ultra Beasts. Some of them stand unmoving, like trees, with their arms and legs stuck into the ground.

name: Celesteela
pokedexEntry: It appeared from the Ultra Wormhole. Witnesses observed it flying across the sky at high speed.

name: Celesteela
pokedexEntry: One kind of Ultra Beast. Witnesses have seen it burn down a forest by expelling gas from its two arms.

name: Celesteela
pokedexEntry: One of the dangerous UBs, high energy readings can be detected coming from both of its huge arms.

name: Celesteela
pokedexEntry: Although it's alien to this world and a danger here, it's apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

name: Celesteela
pokedexEntry: One of the dangerous UBs, high energy readings can be detected coming from both of its huge arms.

name: Celesteela
pokedexEntry: Although it's alien to this world and a danger here, it's apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

name: Kartana
pokedexEntry: This Ultra Beast came from the Ultra Wormhole. It seems not to attack enemies on its own, but its sharp body is a dangerous weapon in itself.

name: Kartana
pokedexEntry: One of the Ultra Beast life-forms, it was observed cutting down a gigantic steel tower with one stroke of its blade.

name: Kartana
pokedexEntry: This Ultra Beast's body, which is as thin as paper, is like a sharpened sword.

name: Kartana
pokedexEntry: Although it's alien to this world and a danger here, it's apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

name: Kartana
pokedexEntry: This Ultra Beast's body, which is as thin as paper, is like a sharpened sword.

name: Kartana
pokedexEntry: Although it's alien to this world and a danger here, it's apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

name: Guzzlord
pokedexEntry: It has gobbled mountains and swallowed whole buildings, according to reports. It's one of the Ultra Beasts.

name: Guzzlord
pokedexEntry: A dangerous Ultra Beast, it appears to be eating constantly, but for some reason its droppings have never been found.

name: Guzzlord
pokedexEntry: Although it's alien to this world and a danger here, it's apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

name: Guzzlord
pokedexEntry: An unknown life-form called a UB. It may be constantly hungry—it is certainly always devouring something.

name: Guzzlord
pokedexEntry: Although it's alien to this world and a danger here, it's apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

name: Guzzlord
pokedexEntry: An unknown life-form called a UB. It may be constantly hungry—it is certainly always devouring something.

name: Necrozma
pokedexEntry: Reminiscent of the Ultra Beasts, this life-form, apparently asleep underground, is thought to have come from another world in ancient times.

name: Necrozma
pokedexEntry: Light is apparently the source of its energy. It has an extraordinarily vicious disposition and is constantly firing off laser beams.

name: Necrozma
pokedexEntry: It looks somehow pained as it rages around in search of light, which serves as its energy. It's apparently from another world.

name: Necrozma
pokedexEntry: Light is the source of its energy. If it isn't devouring light, impurities build up in it and on it, and Necrozma darkens and stops moving.

name: Necrozma
pokedexEntry: It survives by absorbing light. After a long time spent slumbering underground, impurities accumulated within it, causing its body to darken.

name: Necrozma
pokedexEntry: It needs light to survive, and it goes on a rampage seeking it out. Its laser beams will cut anything to pieces.

name: Necrozma
pokedexEntry: This is its form while it is devouring the light of Solgaleo. It pounces on foes and then slashes them with the claws on its four limbs and back.

name: Necrozma
pokedexEntry: This is Necrozma's form while it's absorbing the power of Solgaleo, making it extremely ferocious and impossible to control.

name: Necrozma
pokedexEntry: When it dominates Solgaleo, it takes on this form. It's a vicious Pokémon, mangling prey with its many claws—including those on its back.

name: Necrozma
pokedexEntry: Necrozma has attached itself to Solgaleo. It siphons away its host's limitless energy, exploiting that energy to fuel a rampage.

name: Necrozma
pokedexEntry: Lunala no longer has a will of its own. Now under the control of Necrozma, it continuously expels all of its energy.

name: Necrozma
pokedexEntry: This is its form while it's devouring the light of Lunala. It grasps foes in its giant claws and rips them apart with brute force.

name: Necrozma
pokedexEntry: Necrozma has subjugated Lunala entirely, forcing the unfortunate Pokémon to emit its light energy for Necrozma to consume.

name: Necrozma
pokedexEntry: When Necrozma latches on to Lunala, it becomes vicious, seeing enemies everywhere it looks. It will burn the world with lasers.

name: Necrozma
pokedexEntry: This is its form when it has absorbed overwhelming light energy. It fires laser beams from all over its body.

name: Necrozma
pokedexEntry: The light pouring out from all over its body affects living things and nature, impacting them in various ways.

name: Magearna
pokedexEntry: This artificial Pokémon, constructed more than 500 years ago, can understand human speech but cannot itself speak.

name: Magearna
pokedexEntry: Its mechanized body is merely a vessel. Its true self is its Soul-Heart, an artificial soul.

name: Magearna
pokedexEntry: It synchronizes its consciousness with others to understand their feelings. This faculty makes it useful for taking care of people.

name: Magearna
pokedexEntry: Built roughly 500 years ago by a scientist, the part called the Soul-Heart is the actual life-form.

name: Magearna
pokedexEntry: It synchronizes its consciousness with others to understand their feelings. This faculty makes it useful for taking care of people.

name: Magearna
pokedexEntry: Built roughly 500 years ago by a scientist, the part called the Soul-Heart is the actual life-form.

name: Marshadow
pokedexEntry: Able to conceal itself in shadows, it never appears before humans, so its very existence was the stuff of myth.

name: Marshadow
pokedexEntry: It lurks in the shadows of others, copying their movements and powers. This Pokémon is craven and cowering.

name: Marshadow
pokedexEntry: It slips into the shadows of others and mimics their powers and movements. As it improves, it becomes stronger than those it's imitating.

name: Marshadow
pokedexEntry: It sinks into the shadows of people and Pokémon, where it can understand their feelings and copy their capabilities.

name: Marshadow
pokedexEntry: By slipping into the shadow of a martial arts master and copying their movements, this Pokémon learned the ultimate techniques.

name: Marshadow
pokedexEntry: This Pokémon can conceal itself in any shadow, so it went undiscovered for a long time.

name: Poipole
pokedexEntry: This Ultra Beast is well enough liked to be chosen as a first partner in its own world.

name: Poipole
pokedexEntry: An Ultra Beast that lives in a different world, it cackles wildly as it sprays its opponents with poison from the needles on its head.

name: Poipole
