pokedexEntry: This Ultra Beast is well enough liked to be chosen as a first partner in its own world.

name: Poipole
pokedexEntry: An Ultra Beast that lives in a different world, it cackles wildly as it sprays its opponents with poison from the needles on its head.

name: Naganadel
pokedexEntry: It stores hundreds of liters of poisonous liquid inside its body. It is one of the organisms known as UBs.

name: Naganadel
pokedexEntry: One kind of Ultra Beast, it fires a glowing, venomous liquid from its needles. This liquid is also immensely adhesive.

name: Naganadel
pokedexEntry: It stores hundreds of liters of poisonous liquid inside its body. It is one of the organisms known as UBs.

name: Naganadel
pokedexEntry: One kind of Ultra Beast, it fires a glowing, venomous liquid from its needles. This liquid is also immensely adhesive.

name: Stakataka
pokedexEntry: It appeared from an Ultra Wormhole. Each one appears to be made up of many life-forms stacked one on top of each other.

name: Stakataka
pokedexEntry: When stone walls started moving and attacking, the brute's true identity was this mysterious life-form, which brings to mind an Ultra Beast.

name: Stakataka
pokedexEntry: It appeared from an Ultra Wormhole. Each one appears to be made up of many life-forms stacked one on top of each other.

name: Stakataka
pokedexEntry: When stone walls started moving and attacking, the brute's true identity was this mysterious life-form, which brings to mind an Ultra Beast.

name: Blacephalon
pokedexEntry: It slithers toward people. Then, without warning, it triggers the explosion of its own head. It's apparently one kind of Ultra Beast.

name: Blacephalon
pokedexEntry: A UB that appeared from an Ultra Wormhole, it causes explosions, then takes advantage of opponents' surprise to rob them of their vitality.

name: Blacephalon
pokedexEntry: It slithers toward people. Then, without warning, it triggers the explosion of its own head. It's apparently one kind of Ultra Beast.

name: Blacephalon
pokedexEntry: A UB that appeared from an Ultra Wormhole, it causes explosions, then takes advantage of opponents' surprise to rob them of their vitality.

name: Zeraora
pokedexEntry: It electrifies its claws and tears its opponents apart with them. Even if they dodge its attack, they'll be electrocuted by the flying sparks.

name: Zeraora
pokedexEntry: It approaches its enemies at the speed of lightning, then tears them limb from limb with its sharp claws.

name: Zeraora
pokedexEntry: It runs as fast as lightning strikes, shredding its opponents with its high-voltage claws.

name: Zeraora
pokedexEntry: Electricity sparks from the pads on its limbs. Wherever Zeraora runs, lightning flashes and thunder echoes.

name: Meltan
pokedexEntry: It melts particles of iron and other metals found in the subsoil, so it can absorb them into its body of molten steel.

name: Meltan
pokedexEntry: It melts particles of iron and other metals found in the subsoil, so it can absorb them into its body of molten steel.

name: Meltan
pokedexEntry: It dissolves and eats metal. Circulating liquid metal within its body is how it generates energy.

name: Meltan
pokedexEntry: They live as a group, but when the time comes, one strong Meltan will absorb all the others and evolve.

name: Melmetal
pokedexEntry: Revered long ago for its capacity to create iron from nothing, for some reason it has come back to life after 3,000 years.

name: Melmetal
pokedexEntry: Revered long ago for its capacity to create iron from nothing, for some reason it has come back to life after 3,000 years.

name: Melmetal
pokedexEntry: At the end of its life-span, Melmetal will rust and fall apart. The small shards left behind will eventually be reborn as Meltan.

name: Melmetal
pokedexEntry: Centrifugal force is behind the punches of Melmetal's heavy hex-nut arms. Melmetal is said to deliver the strongest punches of all Pokémon.

name: Melmetal
pokedexEntry: In a distant land, there are legends about a cyclopean giant. In fact, the giant was a Melmetal that was flooded with Gigantamax energy.

name: Melmetal
pokedexEntry: It can send electric beams streaking out from the hole in its belly. The beams' tremendous energy can vaporize an opponent in one shot.

name: Grookey
pokedexEntry: When it uses its special stick to strike up a beat, the sound waves produced carry revitalizing energy to the plants and flowers in the area.

name: Grookey
pokedexEntry: It attacks with rapid beats of its stick. As it strikes with amazing speed, it gets more and more pumped.

name: Thwackey
pokedexEntry: The faster a Thwackey can beat out a rhythm with its two sticks, the more respect it wins from its peers.

name: Thwackey
pokedexEntry: When it's drumming out rapid beats in battle, it gets so caught up in the rhythm that it won't even notice that it's already knocked out its opponent.

name: Rillaboom
pokedexEntry: By drumming, it taps into the power of its special tree stump. The roots of the stump follow its direction in battle.

name: Rillaboom
pokedexEntry: The one with the best drumming techniques becomes the boss of the troop. It has a gentle disposition and values harmony among its group.

name: Rillaboom
pokedexEntry: Gigantamax energy has caused Rillaboom's stump to grow into a drum set that resembles a forest.

name: Rillaboom
pokedexEntry: Rillaboom has become one with its forest of drums and continues to lay down beats that shake all of Galar.

name: Scorbunny
pokedexEntry: A warm-up of running around gets fire energy coursing through this Pokémon's body. Once that happens, it's ready to fight at full power.

name: Scorbunny
pokedexEntry: It has special pads on the backs of its feet, and one on its nose. Once it's raring to fight, these pads radiate tremendous heat.

name: Raboot
pokedexEntry: Its thick and fluffy fur protects it from the cold and enables it to use hotter fire moves.

name: Raboot
pokedexEntry: It kicks berries right off the branches of trees and then juggles them with its feet, practicing its footwork.

name: Cinderace
pokedexEntry: It juggles a pebble with its feet, turning it into a burning soccer ball. Its shots strike opponents hard and leave them scorched.

name: Cinderace
pokedexEntry: It's skilled at both offense and defense, and it gets pumped up when cheered on. But if it starts showboating, it could put itself in a tough spot.

name: Cinderace
pokedexEntry: Infused with Cinderace's fighting spirit, the gigantic Pyro Ball never misses its targets and completely roasts opponents.

name: Cinderace
pokedexEntry: Gigantamax energy can sometimes cause the diameter of this Pokémon's fireball to exceed 300 feet.

name: Sobble
pokedexEntry: When scared, this Pokémon cries. Its tears pack the chemical punch of 100 onions, and attackers won't be able to resist weeping.

name: Sobble
pokedexEntry: When it gets wet, its skin changes color, and this Pokémon becomes invisible as if it were camouflaged.

name: Drizzile
pokedexEntry: A clever combatant, this Pokémon battles using water balloons created with moisture secreted from its palms.

name: Drizzile
pokedexEntry: Highly intelligent but also very lazy, it keeps enemies out of its territory by laying traps everywhere.

name: Inteleon
pokedexEntry: It has many hidden capabilities, such as fingertips that can shoot water and a membrane on its back that it can use to glide through the air.

name: Inteleon
pokedexEntry: Its nictitating membranes let it pick out foes' weak points so it can precisely blast them with water that shoots from its fingertips at Mach 3.

name: Inteleon
pokedexEntry: Gigantamax Inteleon's Water Gun move fires at Mach 7. As the Pokémon takes aim, it uses the crest on its head to gauge wind and temperature.

name: Inteleon
pokedexEntry: It has excellent sniping skills. Shooting a berry rolling along over nine miles away is a piece of cake for this Pokémon.

name: Skwovet
pokedexEntry: Found throughout the Galar region, this Pokémon becomes uneasy if its cheeks are ever completely empty of berries.

name: Skwovet
pokedexEntry: It eats berries nonstop—a habit that has made it more resilient than it looks. It'll show up on farms, searching for yet more berries.

name: Greedent
pokedexEntry: It stashes berries in its tail—so many berries that they fall out constantly. But this Pokémon is a bit slow-witted, so it doesn't notice the loss.

name: Greedent
pokedexEntry: Common throughout the Galar region, this Pokémon has strong teeth and can chew through the toughest of berry shells.

name: Rookidee
pokedexEntry: It will bravely challenge any opponent, no matter how powerful. This Pokémon benefits from every battle—even a defeat increases its strength a bit.

name: Rookidee
pokedexEntry: Jumping nimbly about, this small-bodied Pokémon takes advantage of even the slightest opportunity to disorient larger opponents.

name: Corvisquire
pokedexEntry: Smart enough to use tools in battle, these Pokémon have been seen picking up rocks and flinging them or using ropes to wrap up enemies.

name: Corvisquire
pokedexEntry: The lessons of many harsh battles have taught it how to accurately judge an opponent's strength.

name: Corviknight
pokedexEntry: This Pokémon reigns supreme in the skies of the Galar region. The black luster of its steel body could drive terror into the heart of any foe.

name: Corviknight
pokedexEntry: With their great intellect and flying skills, these Pokémon very successfully act as the Galar region's airborne taxi service.

name: Corviknight
pokedexEntry: Imbued with Gigantamax energy, its wings can whip up winds more forceful than any a hurricane could muster. The gusts blow everything away.

name: Corviknight
pokedexEntry: The eight feathers on its back are called blade birds, and they can launch off its body to attack foes independently.

name: Blipbug
pokedexEntry: A constant collector of information, this Pokémon is very smart. Very strong is what it isn't.

name: Blipbug
pokedexEntry: Often found in gardens, this Pokémon has hairs on its body that it uses to assess its surroundings.

name: Dottler
pokedexEntry: It barely moves, but it's still alive. Hiding in its shell without food or water seems to have awakened its psychic powers.

name: Dottler
pokedexEntry: As it grows inside its shell, it uses its psychic abilities to monitor the outside world and prepare for evolution.

name: Orbeetle
pokedexEntry: It's famous for its high level of intelligence, and the large size of its brain is proof that it also possesses immense psychic power.

name: Orbeetle
pokedexEntry: It emits psychic energy to observe and study what's around it—and what's around it can include things over six miles away.

name: Orbeetle
pokedexEntry: Its brain has grown to a gargantuan size, as has the rest of its body. This Pokémon's intellect and psychic abilities are overpowering.

name: Orbeetle
pokedexEntry: If it were to utilize every last bit of its power, it could control the minds of every living being in its vicinity.

name: Nickit
pokedexEntry: Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it silently raids the food stores of other Pokémon. It survives off its ill-gotten gains.

name: Nickit
pokedexEntry: Cunning and cautious, this Pokémon survives by stealing food from others. It erases its tracks with swipes of its tail as it makes off with its plunder.

name: Thievul
pokedexEntry: It secretly marks potential targets with a scent. By following the scent, it stalks its targets and steals from them when they least expect it.

name: Thievul
pokedexEntry: With a lithe body and sharp claws, it goes around stealing food and eggs. Boltund is its natural enemy.

name: Gossifleur
pokedexEntry: It anchors itself in the ground with its single leg, then basks in the sun. After absorbing enough sunlight, its petals spread as it blooms brilliantly.

name: Gossifleur
pokedexEntry: It whirls around in the wind while singing a joyous song. This delightful display has charmed many into raising this Pokémon.

name: Eldegoss
pokedexEntry: The seeds attached to its cotton fluff are full of nutrients. It spreads them on the wind so that plants and other Pokémon can benefit from them.

name: Eldegoss
pokedexEntry: The cotton on the head of this Pokémon can be spun into a glossy, gorgeous yarn—a Galar regional specialty.

name: Wooloo
pokedexEntry: Its curly fleece is such an effective cushion that this Pokémon could fall off a cliff and stand right back up at the bottom, unharmed.

name: Wooloo
pokedexEntry: If its fleece grows too long, Wooloo won't be able to move. Cloth made with the wool of this Pokémon is surprisingly strong.

name: Dubwool
pokedexEntry: Weave a carpet from its springy wool, and you end up with something closer to a trampoline. You'll start to bounce the moment you set foot on it.

name: Dubwool
pokedexEntry: Its majestic horns are meant only to impress the opposite gender. They never see use in battle.

name: Chewtle
pokedexEntry: Apparently the itch of its teething impels it to snap its jaws at anything in front of it.

name: Chewtle
pokedexEntry: It starts off battles by attacking with its rock-hard horn, but as soon as the opponent flinches, this Pokémon bites down and never lets go.

name: Drednaw
pokedexEntry: With jaws that can shear through steel rods, this highly aggressive Pokémon chomps down on its unfortunate prey.

name: Drednaw
pokedexEntry: This Pokémon rapidly extends its retractable neck to sink its sharp fangs into distant enemies and take them down.

name: Drednaw
pokedexEntry: It responded to Gigantamax energy by becoming bipedal. First it comes crashing down on foes, and then it finishes them off with its massive jaws.

name: Drednaw
pokedexEntry: In the Galar region, there's a tale about this Pokémon chewing up a mountain and using the rubble to stop a flood.

name: Yamper
pokedexEntry: This Pokémon is very popular as a herding dog in the Galar region. As it runs, it generates electricity from the base of its tail.

name: Yamper
pokedexEntry: This gluttonous Pokémon only assists people with their work because it wants treats. As it runs, it crackles with electricity.

name: Boltund
pokedexEntry: This Pokémon generates electricity and channels it into its legs to keep them going strong. Boltund can run nonstop for three full days.

name: Boltund
pokedexEntry: It sends electricity through its legs to boost their strength. Running at top speed, it easily breaks 50 mph.

name: Rolycoly
pokedexEntry: Most of its body has the same composition as coal. Fittingly, this Pokémon was first discovered in coal mines about 400 years ago.

name: Rolycoly
pokedexEntry: It can race around like a unicycle, even on rough, rocky terrain. Burning coal sustains it.

name: Carkol
pokedexEntry: It forms coal inside its body. Coal dropped by this Pokémon once helped fuel the lives of people in the Galar region.

name: Carkol
pokedexEntry: By rapidly rolling its legs, it can travel at over 18 mph. The temperature of the flames it breathes exceeds 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Coalossal
pokedexEntry: It's usually peaceful, but the vandalism of mines enrages it. Offenders will be incinerated with flames that reach 2,700 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Coalossal
pokedexEntry: While it's engaged in battle, its mountain of coal will burn bright red, sending off sparks that scorch the surrounding area.

name: Coalossal
pokedexEntry: Its body is a colossal stove. With Gigantamax energy stoking the fire, this Pokémon's flame burns hotter than 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Coalossal
pokedexEntry: When Galar was hit by a harsh cold wave, this Pokémon served as a giant heating stove and saved many lives.

name: Applin
pokedexEntry: It spends its entire life inside an apple. It hides from its natural enemies, bird Pokémon, by pretending it's just an apple and nothing more.

name: Applin
pokedexEntry: As soon as it's born, it burrows into an apple. Not only does the apple serve as its food source, but the flavor of the fruit determines its evolution.

name: Flapple
pokedexEntry: It ate a sour apple, and that induced its evolution. In its cheeks, it stores an acid capable of causing chemical burns.

name: Flapple
pokedexEntry: It flies on wings of apple skin and spits a powerful acid. It can also change its shape into that of an apple.

name: Flapple
pokedexEntry: Under the influence of Gigantamax energy, it produces much more sweet nectar, and its shape has changed to resemble a giant apple.

name: Flapple
pokedexEntry: If it stretches its neck, the strong aroma of its nectar pours out. The scent is so sickeningly sweet that one whiff makes other Pokémon faint.

name: Appletun
pokedexEntry: Eating a sweet apple caused its evolution. A nectarous scent wafts from its body, luring in the bug Pokémon it preys on.

name: Appletun
pokedexEntry: Its body is covered in sweet nectar, and the skin on its back is especially yummy. Children used to have it as a snack.

name: Appletun
pokedexEntry: It blasts its opponents with massive amounts of sweet, sticky nectar, drowning them under the deluge.

name: Appletun
pokedexEntry: Due to Gigantamax energy, this Pokémon's nectar has thickened. The increased viscosity lets the nectar absorb more damage than before.

name: Silicobra
pokedexEntry: As it digs, it swallows sand and stores it in its neck pouch. The pouch can hold more than 17 pounds of sand.

name: Silicobra
pokedexEntry: It spews sand from its nostrils. While the enemy is blinded, it burrows into the ground to hide.

name: Sandaconda
pokedexEntry: When it contracts its body, over 220 pounds of sand sprays from its nose. If it ever runs out of sand, it becomes disheartened.

name: Sandaconda
pokedexEntry: Its unique style of coiling allows it to blast sand out of its sand sac more efficiently.

name: Sandaconda
pokedexEntry: Its sand pouch has grown to tremendous proportions. More than 1,000,000 tons of sand now swirl around its body.

name: Sandaconda
pokedexEntry: Sand swirls around its body with such speed and power that it could pulverize a skyscraper.

name: Cramorant
pokedexEntry: It's so strong that it can knock out some opponents in a single hit, but it also may forget what it's battling midfight.

name: Cramorant
pokedexEntry: This hungry Pokémon swallows Arrokuda whole. Occasionally, it makes a mistake and tries to swallow a Pokémon other than its preferred prey.

name: Cramorant
pokedexEntry: Cramorant's gluttony led it to try to swallow an Arrokuda whole, which in turn led to Cramorant getting an Arrokuda stuck in its throat.

name: Cramorant
pokedexEntry: The slightest shock is sometimes enough to get this Pokémon to spit out the Arrokuda lodged in its throat.

name: Cramorant
pokedexEntry: This Cramorant has accidentally gotten a Pikachu lodged in its gullet. Cramorant is choking a little, but it isn't really bothered.

name: Cramorant
pokedexEntry: The half-swallowed Pikachu is so startled that it isn't struggling yet, but it's still looking for a chance to strike back.

name: Arrokuda
pokedexEntry: If it sees any movement around it, this Pokémon charges for it straightaway, leading with its sharply pointed jaw. It's very proud of that jaw.

name: Arrokuda
pokedexEntry: After it's eaten its fill, its movements become extremely sluggish. That's when Cramorant swallows it up.

name: Barraskewda
pokedexEntry: This Pokémon has a jaw that's as sharp as a spear and as strong as steel. Apparently Barraskewda's flesh is surprisingly tasty, too.

name: Barraskewda
pokedexEntry: It spins its tail fins to propel itself, surging forward at speeds of over 100 knots before ramming prey and spearing into them.

name: Toxel
pokedexEntry: It stores poison in an internal poison sac and secretes that poison through its skin. If you touch this Pokémon, a tingling sensation follows.

name: Toxel
pokedexEntry: It manipulates the chemical makeup of its poison to produce electricity. The voltage is weak, but it can cause a tingling paralysis.

name: Toxtricity
pokedexEntry: When this Pokémon sounds as if it's strumming a guitar, it's actually clawing at the protrusions on its chest to generate electricity.

name: Toxtricity
pokedexEntry: This short-tempered and aggressive Pokémon chugs stagnant water to absorb any toxins it might contain.

name: Toxtricity
pokedexEntry: Capable of generating 15,000 volts of electricity, this Pokémon looks down on all that would challenge it.

name: Toxtricity
pokedexEntry: It has an electrical organ on its chest. While generating electricity, it fills its surroundings with what sounds like the strumming of a bass guitar.

name: Toxtricity
pokedexEntry: Its excessive electric energy is its weapon. This Pokémon can build up more electricity than any thundercloud.

name: Toxtricity
pokedexEntry: Out of control after its own poison penetrated its brain, it tears across the land in a rampage, contaminating the earth with toxic sweat.

name: Sizzlipede
pokedexEntry: It stores flammable gas in its body and uses it to generate heat. The yellow sections on its belly get particularly hot.

name: Sizzlipede
pokedexEntry: It wraps prey up with its heated body, cooking them in its coils. Once they're well-done, it will voraciously nibble them down to the last morsel.

name: Centiskorch
pokedexEntry: When it heats up, its body temperature reaches about 1,500 degrees Fahrenheit. It lashes its body like a whip and launches itself at enemies.

name: Centiskorch
pokedexEntry: While its burning body is already dangerous on its own, this excessively hostile Pokémon also has large and very sharp fangs.

name: Centiskorch
pokedexEntry: Gigantamax energy has evoked a rise in its body temperature, now reaching over 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit. Its heat waves incinerate its enemies.

name: Centiskorch
pokedexEntry: The heat that comes off a Gigantamax Centiskorch may destabilize air currents. Sometimes it can even cause storms.

name: Clobbopus
pokedexEntry: It's very curious, but its means of investigating things is to try to punch them with its tentacles. The search for food is what brings it onto land.

name: Clobbopus
pokedexEntry: Its tentacles tear off easily, but it isn't alarmed when that happens—it knows they'll grow back. It's about as smart as a three-year-old.

name: Grapploct
pokedexEntry: A body made up of nothing but muscle makes the grappling moves this Pokémon performs with its tentacles tremendously powerful.

name: Grapploct
pokedexEntry: Searching for an opponent to test its skills against, it emerges onto land. Once the battle is over, it returns to the sea.

name: Sinistea
pokedexEntry: This Pokémon is said to have been born when a lonely spirit possessed a cold, leftover cup of tea.

name: Sinistea
pokedexEntry: The teacup in which this Pokémon makes its home is a famous piece of antique tableware. Many forgeries are in circulation.

name: Sinistea
pokedexEntry: The swirl pattern in this Pokémon's body is its weakness. If it gets stirred, the swirl loses its shape, and Sinistea gets dizzy.

name: Sinistea
pokedexEntry: It absorbs the life-force of those who drink it. It waits patiently, but opportunities are fleeting—it tastes so bad that it gets spat out immediately.

name: Polteageist
pokedexEntry: This species lives in antique teapots. Most pots are forgeries, but on rare occasions, an authentic work is found.

name: Polteageist
pokedexEntry: Leaving leftover black tea unattended is asking for this Pokémon to come along and pour itself into it, turning the tea into a new Polteageist.

name: Polteageist
pokedexEntry: Trainers Polteageist trusts will be allowed to experience its distinctive flavor and aroma firsthand by sampling just a tiny bit of its tea.

name: Polteageist
pokedexEntry: When angered, it launches tea from its body at the offender's mouth. The tea causes strong chills if swallowed.

name: Hatenna
pokedexEntry: Via the protrusion on its head, it senses other creatures' emotions. If you don't have a calm disposition, it will never warm up to you.

name: Hatenna
pokedexEntry: If this Pokémon senses a strong emotion, it will run away as fast as it can. It prefers areas without people.

name: Hattrem
pokedexEntry: No matter who you are, if you bring strong emotions near this Pokémon, it will silence you violently.

name: Hattrem
pokedexEntry: Using the braids on its head, it pummels foes to get them to quiet down. One blow from those braids would knock out a professional boxer.

name: Hatterene
pokedexEntry: It emits psychic power strong enough to cause headaches as a deterrent to the approach of others.

name: Hatterene
pokedexEntry: If you're too loud around it, you risk being torn apart by the claws on its tentacle. This Pokémon is also known as the Forest Witch.

name: Hatterene
pokedexEntry: This Pokémon can read the emotions of creatures over 30 miles away. The minute it senses hostility, it goes on the attack.

name: Hatterene
pokedexEntry: Beams like lightning shoot down from its tentacles. It's known to some as the Raging Goddess.

name: Impidimp
pokedexEntry: Through its nose, it sucks in the emanations produced by people and Pokémon when they feel annoyed. It thrives off this negative energy.

name: Impidimp
pokedexEntry: It sneaks into people's homes, stealing things and feasting on the negative energy of the frustrated occupants.

name: Morgrem
pokedexEntry: When it gets down on all fours as if to beg for forgiveness, it's trying to lure opponents in so that it can stab them with its spear-like hair.

name: Morgrem
pokedexEntry: With sly cunning, it tries to lure people into the woods. Some believe it to have the power to make crops grow.

name: Grimmsnarl
pokedexEntry: With the hair wrapped around its body helping to enhance its muscles, this Pokémon can overwhelm even Machamp.

name: Grimmsnarl
pokedexEntry: Its hairs work like muscle fibers. When its hairs unfurl, they latch on to opponents, ensnaring them as tentacles would.

name: Grimmsnarl
pokedexEntry: By transforming its leg hair, this Pokémon delivers power-packed drill kicks that can bore huge holes in Galar's terrain.

name: Grimmsnarl
pokedexEntry: Gigantamax energy has caused more hair to sprout all over its body. With the added strength, it can jump over the world's tallest building.

name: Obstagoon
pokedexEntry: Its voice is staggering in volume. Obstagoon has a tendency to take on a threatening posture and shout—this move is known as Obstruct.

name: Obstagoon
pokedexEntry: It evolved after experiencing numerous fights. While crossing its arms, it lets out a shout that would make any opponent flinch.

name: Perrserker
pokedexEntry: What appears to be an iron helmet is actually hardened hair. This Pokémon lives for the thrill of battle.

name: Perrserker
pokedexEntry: After many battles, it evolved dangerous claws that come together to form daggers when extended.

name: Cursola
pokedexEntry: Its shell is overflowing with its heightened otherworldly energy. The ectoplasm serves as protection for this Pokémon's core spirit.

name: Cursola
pokedexEntry: Be cautious of the ectoplasmic body surrounding its soul. You'll become stiff as stone if you touch it.

name: Sirfetch'd
pokedexEntry: Only Farfetch'd that have survived many battles can attain this evolution. When this Pokémon's leek withers, it will retire from combat.

name: Sirfetch'd
pokedexEntry: After deflecting attacks with its hard leaf shield, it strikes back with its sharp leek stalk. The leek stalk is both weapon and food.

name: Mr. Rime
pokedexEntry: It's highly skilled at tap-dancing. It waves its cane of ice in time with its graceful movements.

name: Mr. Rime
pokedexEntry: Its amusing movements make it very popular. It releases its psychic power from the pattern on its belly.

name: Runerigus
pokedexEntry: A powerful curse was woven into an ancient painting. After absorbing the spirit of a Yamask, the painting began to move.

name: Runerigus
pokedexEntry: Never touch its shadowlike body, or you'll be shown the horrific memories behind the picture carved into it.

name: Milcery
pokedexEntry: This Pokémon was born from sweet-smelling particles in the air. Its body is made of cream.

name: Milcery
pokedexEntry: They say that any patisserie visited by Milcery is guaranteed success and good fortune.

name: Alcremie
pokedexEntry: When it trusts a Trainer, it will treat them to berries it's decorated with cream.

name: Alcremie
pokedexEntry: When Alcremie is content, the cream it secretes from its hands becomes sweeter and richer.

name: Alcremie
pokedexEntry: The moment it evolved, it took on a sweet and tart flavor. This is because of the way its cells spontaneously shifted during evolution.

name: Alcremie
pokedexEntry: The cells that compose its cream fluctuated suddenly during evolution, giving the cream a sweet and tart flavor.

name: Alcremie
pokedexEntry: The moment it evolved, it took on an aromatic flavor. This is because of the way its cells spontaneously shifted during evolution.

name: Alcremie
pokedexEntry: The cells that compose its cream fluctuated suddenly during evolution, giving the cream an aromatic flavor.

name: Alcremie
pokedexEntry: The moment it evolved, it took on a refreshing flavor. This is because of the way its cells spontaneously shifted during evolution.

name: Alcremie
pokedexEntry: The cells that compose its cream fluctuated suddenly during evolution, giving the cream a refreshing flavor.

name: Alcremie
pokedexEntry: The moment it evolved, it took on a sour flavor. This is because of the way its cells spontaneously shifted during evolution.

name: Alcremie
pokedexEntry: The cells that compose its cream fluctuated suddenly during evolution, giving the cream a sour flavor.

name: Alcremie
pokedexEntry: The moment it evolved, it took on a salty flavor. This is because of the way its cells spontaneously shifted during evolution.

name: Alcremie
pokedexEntry: The cells that compose its cream fluctuated suddenly during evolution, giving the cream a salty flavor.

name: Alcremie
pokedexEntry: The moment it evolved, it took on a mixed flavor. This is because of the way its cells spontaneously shifted during evolution.

name: Alcremie
pokedexEntry: The cells that compose its cream fluctuated suddenly during evolution, giving the cream a mixed flavor.

name: Alcremie
pokedexEntry: The moment it evolved, it took on a bitter flavor. This is because of the way its cells spontaneously shifted during evolution.

name: Alcremie
pokedexEntry: The cells that compose its cream fluctuated suddenly during evolution, giving the cream a bitter flavor.

name: Alcremie
pokedexEntry: The moment it evolved, it took on a complex flavor. This is because of the way its cells spontaneously shifted during evolution.

name: Alcremie
pokedexEntry: The cells that compose its cream fluctuated suddenly during evolution, giving the cream a complex flavor.

name: Falinks
pokedexEntry: Five of them are troopers, and one is the brass. The brass's orders are absolute.

name: Falinks
pokedexEntry: The six of them work together as one Pokémon. Teamwork is also their battle strategy, and they constantly change their formation as they fight.

name: Pincurchin
pokedexEntry: It feeds on seaweed, using its teeth to scrape it off rocks. Electric current flows from the tips of its spines.

name: Pincurchin
pokedexEntry: It stores electricity in each spine. Even if one gets broken off, it still continues to emit electricity for at least three hours.

name: Snom
pokedexEntry: It spits out thread imbued with a frigid sort of energy and uses it to tie its body to branches, disguising itself as an icicle while it sleeps.

name: Snom
pokedexEntry: It eats snow that piles up on the ground. The more snow it eats, the bigger and more impressive the spikes on its back grow.

name: Frosmoth
pokedexEntry: Icy scales fall from its wings like snow as it flies over fields and mountains. The temperature of its wings is less than -290 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Frosmoth
pokedexEntry: It shows no mercy to any who desecrate fields and mountains. It will fly around on its icy wings, causing a blizzard to chase offenders away.

name: Stonjourner
pokedexEntry: It stands in grasslands, watching the sun's descent from zenith to horizon. This Pokémon has a talent for delivering dynamic kicks.

name: Stonjourner
pokedexEntry: Once a year, on a specific date and at a specific time, they gather out of nowhere and form up in a circle.

name: Eiscue
pokedexEntry: It drifted in on the flow of ocean waters from a frigid place. It keeps its head iced constantly to make sure it stays nice and cold.

name: Eiscue
pokedexEntry: This Pokémon keeps its heat-sensitive head cool with ice. It fishes for its food, dangling its single hair into the sea to lure in prey.

name: Eiscue
pokedexEntry: The ice covering this Pokémon's face has shattered, revealing a slightly worried expression that many people are enamored with.

name: Eiscue
pokedexEntry: The hair on its head connects to the surface of its brain. When this Pokémon has something on its mind, its hair chills the air around it.

name: Indeedee
pokedexEntry: It uses the horns on its head to sense the emotions of others. Males will act as valets for those they serve, looking after their every need.

name: Indeedee
pokedexEntry: Through its horns, it can pick up on the emotions of creatures around it. Positive emotions are the source of its strength.

name: Indeedee
pokedexEntry: These intelligent Pokémon touch horns with each other to share information between them.

name: Indeedee
pokedexEntry: They diligently serve people and Pokémon so they can gather feelings of gratitude. The females are particularly good at babysitting.

name: Morpeko
pokedexEntry: As it eats the seeds stored up in its pocket-like pouches, this Pokémon is not just satisfying its constant hunger. It's also generating electricity.

name: Morpeko
pokedexEntry: It carries electrically roasted seeds with it as if they're precious treasures. No matter how much it eats, it always gets hungry again in short order.

name: Morpeko
pokedexEntry: Intense hunger drives it to extremes of violence, and the electricity in its cheek sacs has converted into a Dark-type energy.

name: Morpeko
pokedexEntry: Hunger hormones affect its temperament. Until its hunger is appeased, it gets up to all manner of evil deeds.

name: Cufant
pokedexEntry: It digs up the ground with its trunk. It's also very strong, being able to carry loads of over five tons without any problem at all.

name: Cufant
pokedexEntry: If a job requires serious strength, this Pokémon will excel at it. Its copper body tarnishes in the rain, turning a vibrant green color.

name: Copperajah
pokedexEntry: They came over from another region long ago and worked together with humans. Their green skin is resistant to water.

name: Copperajah
pokedexEntry: These Pokémon live in herds. Their trunks have incredible grip strength, strong enough to crush giant rocks into powder.

name: Copperajah
pokedexEntry: So much power is packed within its trunk that if it were to unleash that power, the resulting blast could level mountains and change the landscape.

name: Copperajah
pokedexEntry: After this Pokémon has Gigantamaxed, its massive nose can utterly demolish large structures with a single smashing blow.

name: Dracozolt
pokedexEntry: In ancient times, it was unbeatable thanks to its powerful lower body, but it went extinct anyway after it depleted all its plant-based food sources.

name: Dracozolt
pokedexEntry: The powerful muscles in its tail generate its electricity. Compared to its lower body, its upper half is entirely too small.

name: Arctozolt
pokedexEntry: The shaking of its freezing upper half is what generates its electricity. It has a hard time walking around.

name: Arctozolt
pokedexEntry: This Pokémon lived on prehistoric seashores and was able to preserve food with the ice on its body. It went extinct because it moved so slowly.

name: Dracovish
pokedexEntry: Powerful legs and jaws made it the apex predator of its time. Its own overhunting of its prey was what drove it to extinction.

name: Dracovish
pokedexEntry: Its mighty legs are capable of running at speeds exceeding 40 mph, but this Pokémon can't breathe unless it's underwater.

name: Arctovish
pokedexEntry: Though it's able to capture prey by freezing its surroundings, it has trouble eating the prey afterward because its mouth is on top of its head.

name: Arctovish
pokedexEntry: The skin on its face is impervious to attack, but breathing difficulties made this Pokémon go extinct anyway.

name: Duraludon
pokedexEntry: Its body resembles polished metal, and it's both lightweight and strong. The only drawback is that it rusts easily.

name: Duraludon
pokedexEntry: The special metal that composes its body is very light, so this Pokémon has considerable agility. It lives in caves because it dislikes the rain.

name: Duraludon
pokedexEntry: It's grown to resemble a skyscraper. Parts of its towering body glow due to a profusion of energy.

name: Duraludon
pokedexEntry: The hardness of its cells is exceptional, even among Steel types. It also has a body structure that's resistant to earthquakes.

name: Dreepy
pokedexEntry: After being reborn as a ghost Pokémon, Dreepy wanders the areas it used to inhabit back when it was alive in prehistoric seas.

name: Dreepy
pokedexEntry: If this weak Pokémon is by itself, a mere child could defeat it. But if Dreepy has friends to help it train, it can evolve and become much stronger.

name: Drakloak
pokedexEntry: It's capable of flying faster than 120 mph. It battles alongside Dreepy and dotes on them until they successfully evolve.

name: Drakloak
pokedexEntry: Without a Dreepy to place on its head and care for, it gets so uneasy it'll try to substitute any Pokémon it finds for the missing Dreepy.

name: Dragapult
pokedexEntry: When it isn't battling, it keeps Dreepy in the holes on its horns. Once a fight starts, it launches the Dreepy like supersonic missiles.

name: Dragapult
pokedexEntry: Apparently the Dreepy inside Dragapult's horns eagerly look forward to being launched out at Mach speeds.

name: Zacian
pokedexEntry: Now armed with a weapon it used in ancient times, this Pokémon needs only a single strike to fell even Gigantamax Pokémon.

name: Zacian
pokedexEntry: Able to cut down anything with a single strike, it became known as the Fairy King's Sword, and it inspired awe in friend and foe alike.

name: Zacian
pokedexEntry: Known as a legendary hero, this Pokémon absorbs metal particles, transforming them into a weapon it uses to battle.

name: Zacian
pokedexEntry: This Pokémon has slumbered for many years. Some say it's Zamazenta's elder sister—others say the two Pokémon are rivals.

name: Zamazenta
pokedexEntry: Its ability to deflect any attack led to it being known as the Fighting Master's Shield. It was feared and respected by all.

name: Zamazenta
pokedexEntry: Now that it's equipped with its shield, it can shrug off impressive blows, including the attacks of Dynamax Pokémon.

name: Zamazenta
pokedexEntry: In times past, it worked together with a king of the people to save the Galar region. It absorbs metal that it then uses in battle.

name: Zamazenta
pokedexEntry: This Pokémon slept for aeons while in the form of a statue. It was asleep for so long, people forgot that it ever existed.

name: Eternatus
pokedexEntry: The core on its chest absorbs energy emanating from the lands of the Galar region. This energy is what allows Eternatus to stay active.

name: Eternatus
pokedexEntry: It was inside a meteorite that fell 20,000 years ago. There seems to be a connection between this Pokémon and the Dynamax phenomenon.

name: Eternatus
pokedexEntry: As a result of Rose's meddling, Eternatus absorbed all the energy in the Galar region. It's now in a state of power overload.

name: Eternatus
pokedexEntry: Infinite amounts of energy pour from this Pokémon's enlarged core, warping the surrounding space-time.

name: Kubfu
pokedexEntry: Kubfu trains hard to perfect its moves. The moves it masters will determine which form it takes when it evolves.

name: Kubfu
pokedexEntry: If Kubfu pulls the long white hair on its head, its fighting spirit heightens and power wells up from the depths of its belly.

name: Urshifu
pokedexEntry: This form of Urshifu is a strong believer in the one-hit KO. Its strategy is to leap in close to foes and land a devastating blow with a hardened fist.

name: Urshifu
pokedexEntry: Inhabiting the mountains of a distant region, this Pokémon races across sheer cliffs, training its legs and refining its moves.

name: Urshifu
pokedexEntry: It's believed that this Pokémon modeled its fighting style on the flow of a river — sometimes rapid, sometimes calm.

name: Urshifu
pokedexEntry: This form of Urshifu is a strong believer in defeating foes by raining many blows down on them. Its strikes are nonstop, flowing like a river.

name: Urshifu
pokedexEntry: People call it the embodiment of rage. It's said that this Pokémon's terrifying expression and shout will rid the world of malevolence.

name: Urshifu
pokedexEntry: The energy released by this Pokémon's fists forms shock waves that can blow away Dynamax Pokémon in just one hit.

name: Urshifu
pokedexEntry: As it waits for the right moment to unleash its Gigantamax power, this Pokémon maintains a perfect one-legged stance. It won't even twitch.

name: Urshifu
pokedexEntry: All it takes is a glare from this Pokémon to take the lives of those with evil in their hearts — or so they say.

name: Zarude
pokedexEntry: Within dense forests, this Pokémon lives in a pack with others of its kind. It’s incredibly aggressive, and the other Pokémon of the forest fear it.

name: Zarude
pokedexEntry: Once the vines on Zarude’s body tear off, they become nutrients in the soil. This helps the plants of the forest grow.

name: Regieleki
pokedexEntry: This Pokemon is a cluster of electrical energy. It's said that removing the rings on Regieleki's body will unleash the Pokémon's latent power.

name: Regieleki
pokedexEntry: Its entire body is made up of an single organ that generates electrical energy. Regieleki is capable of creating all of Galar's electricity.

name: Regidrago
pokedexEntry: An academic theory proposes that Regidrago's arms were once the head of an ancient dragon. The theory remains unproven.

name: Regidrago
pokedexEntry: Its body is composed of crystalized dragon energy. Regidrago is said to have the powers of every dragon Pokémon.

name: Glastrier
pokedexEntry: Glastrier emits intense cold from its hooves. It's also a belligerent Pokémon—anything it wants, it takes by force.

name: Glastrier
pokedexEntry: Glastrier has tremendous physical strength, and the mask of ice covering its face is 100 times harder than diamond.

name: Spectrier
pokedexEntry: It probes its surroundings with all its senses save one—it doesn't use its sense of sight. Spectrier's kicks are said to separate soul from body.

name: Spectrier
pokedexEntry: As it dashes through the night, Spectrier absorbs the life-force of sleeping creatures. It craves silence and solitude.

name: Calyrex
pokedexEntry: Calyrex is a merciful Pokémon, capable of providing healing and blessings. It reigned over the Galar region in times of yore.

name: Calyrex
pokedexEntry: Calyrex is known in legend as a king that ruled over Galar in ancient times. It has the power to cause hearts to mend and plants to spring forth.

name: Calyrex
pokedexEntry: According to lore, this Pokémon showed no mercy to those who got in its way, yet it would heal its opponents' wounds after battle.

name: Calyrex
pokedexEntry: It's said that this Pokémon once moved a large forest—and all the Pokémon living there—to a new location overnight.

name: Calyrex
pokedexEntry: It's said that Calyrex and a Pokémon that had bonded with it ran all across the Galar region to bring green to the wastelands.

name: Calyrex
pokedexEntry: Legend says that by using its power to see all events from past to future, this Pokémon saved the creatures of a forest from a meteorite strike.
